function loadStorage() {
loadFolders();
const currentBuildId = window.__PRELOADED_BUILD_ID__ || '';
const lastSyncedBuildId = localStorage.getItem('matrix_synced_build_id') || '';
const isNewPreloadedBuild = Boolean(currentBuildId && currentBuildId !== lastSyncedBuildId);

if (isNewPreloadedBuild) {
try {
localStorage.removeItem('matrix_locally_modified_ids_v2');
localStorage.setItem('matrix_synced_build_id', currentBuildId);
} catch (e) {}
}

let localDeleted = [];
try {
const rawDel = localStorage.getItem('matrix_deleted_topic_ids_v2');
if (rawDel) {
const parsedDel = JSON.parse(rawDel);
if (Array.isArray(parsedDel)) localDeleted = parsedDel;
}
} catch (e) {}

const preloadedDeleted = Array.isArray(window.__DELETED_TOPIC_IDS__) ? window.__DELETED_TOPIC_IDS__ : [];
deletedTopicIds = mergeDeletedIds(preloadedDeleted, localDeleted);

const preloaded = Array.isArray(window.__PRELOADED_LIBRARY__) ? window.__PRELOADED_LIBRARY__ : [];

let localTopics = [];
if (!isNewPreloadedBuild) {
const keysToCheck = ['matrix_quiz_topics_v2', 'matrix_quiz_topics_v1', 'matrix_quiz_topics'];
keysToCheck.forEach(k => {
try {
const raw = localStorage.getItem(k);
if (raw) {
const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
localTopics = mergeTopicLists(localTopics, parsed, deletedTopicIds);
}
}
if (k !== 'matrix_quiz_topics_v2') {
localStorage.removeItem(k);
}
} catch (e) {}
});
}

savedTopics = isNewPreloadedBuild
? mergeTopicLists(preloaded, [], deletedTopicIds)
: mergeTopicLists(preloaded, localTopics, deletedTopicIds);

try {
localStorage.setItem('matrix_quiz_topics_v2', JSON.stringify(savedTopics));
localStorage.setItem('matrix_deleted_topic_ids_v2', JSON.stringify(deletedTopicIds));
} catch (e) {}

updateLibraryCountersUI();

if (isNewPreloadedBuild) {
saveToIndexedDB(savedTopics, deletedTopicIds);
} else {
loadFromIndexedDB().then(idbResult => {
if (idbResult) {
if (Array.isArray(idbResult.deletedIds)) {
deletedTopicIds = mergeDeletedIds(deletedTopicIds, idbResult.deletedIds);
}
if (Array.isArray(idbResult.topics)) {
savedTopics = mergeTopicLists(savedTopics, idbResult.topics, deletedTopicIds);
} else {
savedTopics = mergeTopicLists(savedTopics, [], deletedTopicIds);
}
try {
localStorage.setItem('matrix_quiz_topics_v2', JSON.stringify(savedTopics));
localStorage.setItem('matrix_deleted_topic_ids_v2', JSON.stringify(deletedTopicIds));
} catch (err) {}
saveToIndexedDB(savedTopics, deletedTopicIds);
updateLibraryCountersUI();
renderLibraryList();
}
});
}
}

function saveToStorage() {
try {
localStorage.setItem('matrix_quiz_topics_v2', JSON.stringify(savedTopics));
localStorage.setItem('matrix_deleted_topic_ids_v2', JSON.stringify(deletedTopicIds));
} catch (e) {}
saveToIndexedDB(savedTopics, deletedTopicIds);
updateLibraryCountersUI();
}

function exportLibraryBackupJson() {
cmLoad();
if (savedTopics.length === 0 && libraryFolders.length === 0 && classesData.length === 0) {
showModal('Thông báo', 'Thư viện hiện đang trống!', 'info');
return;
}
const dataStr = JSON.stringify({ app: 'quiz-library', version: 3, topics: savedTopics, folders: libraryFolders, classes: classesData }, null, 2);
const blob = new Blob([dataStr], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });
const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
const a = document.createElement('a');
a.href = url;
a.download = `Thu_Vien_Ma_Tran_Backup_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`;
document.body.appendChild(a);
a.click();
document.body.removeChild(a);
URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

function importLibraryBackupJson(event) {
const file = event.target?.files?.[0];
if (!file) return;
const reader = new FileReader();
reader.onload = (e) => {
try {
const parsedFile = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
const imported = Array.isArray(parsedFile) ? parsedFile : (Array.isArray(parsedFile.topics) ? parsedFile.topics : []);
if (!Array.isArray(parsedFile) && !Array.isArray(parsedFile.topics) && !Array.isArray(parsedFile.classes)) throw new Error('Invalid format');
const importedFolders = (!Array.isArray(parsedFile) && Array.isArray(parsedFile.folders)) ? parsedFile.folders : [];
if (importedFolders.length) {
const fIds = new Set(importedFolders.map(f => f && f.id).filter(Boolean));
deletedFolderIds = deletedFolderIds.filter(id => !fIds.has(id));
const fMap = new Map(libraryFolders.map(f => [f.id, f]));
importedFolders.forEach(f => { if (f && f.id && f.name) fMap.set(f.id, f); });
libraryFolders = Array.from(fMap.values());
saveFolders();
}
// [CODE19] khôi phục cả danh sách lớp học (nếu có)
if (!Array.isArray(parsedFile) && Array.isArray(parsedFile.classes)) {
cmLoad();
const cMap = new Map(classesData.map(c => [c.id, c]));
parsedFile.classes.forEach(c => { if (c && c.id && c.name) cMap.set(c.id, c); });
classesData = Array.from(cMap.values());
cmSave();
}
const importedIds = new Set(imported.map(item => item && item.id).filter(Boolean));
deletedTopicIds = deletedTopicIds.filter(id => !importedIds.has(id));
imported.forEach(item => {
if (item && item.id) markTopicLocallyModified(item.id);
});
savedTopics = mergeTopicLists(imported, savedTopics, deletedTopicIds);
saveToStorage();
renderLibraryList();
if (imported.length > 0) {
applyTopic(imported[imported.length - 1]);
}
showModal('Thành công!', `Đã nạp thành công ${imported.length} chủ đề (Tổng cộng trong Thư viện: ${savedTopics.length} chủ đề)!`, 'success');
} catch (err) {
showModal('Lỗi định dạng', 'File sao lưu không hợp lệ.', 'info');
}
event.target.value = '';
};
reader.readAsText(file);
}

const PRINT_PRESET_STEPS = [
{ qGap: '4.5px', qPad: '4.5px 7.5px', qFont: '20px', titleMb: '3px', optGap: '3px', optPad: '2.5px 5.5px', optFont: '20px', badgeSize: '24px', badgeFont: '15px' },
{ qGap: '3.5px', qPad: '3.5px 6.5px', qFont: '20px', titleMb: '2.5px', optGap: '2.5px', optPad: '2px 5px', optFont: '20px', badgeSize: '23px', badgeFont: '14.5px' },
{ qGap: '3px', qPad: '3px 6px', qFont: '20px', titleMb: '2px', optGap: '2px', optPad: '1.8px 4.5px', optFont: '20px', badgeSize: '22px', badgeFont: '14px' },
{ qGap: '2.5px', qPad: '2.5px 5.5px', qFont: '20px', titleMb: '1.5px', optGap: '1.8px', optPad: '1.5px 4px', optFont: '20px', badgeSize: '21px', badgeFont: '13.5px' }
];

function applyPrintPresetStep(step) {
const root = document.documentElement;
root.style.setProperty('--print-q-gap', step.qGap);
root.style.setProperty('--print-q-pad', step.qPad);
root.style.setProperty('--print-q-font', step.qFont);
root.style.setProperty('--print-title-mb', step.titleMb);
root.style.setProperty('--print-opt-gap', step.optGap);
root.style.setProperty('--print-opt-pad', step.optPad);
root.style.setProperty('--print-opt-font', step.optFont);
root.style.setProperty('--print-badge-size', step.badgeSize);
root.style.setProperty('--print-badge-font', step.badgeFont);
}

function measureQuestionsNaturalHeight(qContainer) {
const cards = qContainer.children;
if (!cards || cards.length === 0) return 0;
const firstRect = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect();
const lastRect = cards[cards.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect();
return lastRect.bottom - firstRect.top;
}

function preparePrintLayout() {
isPrintingMode = true;
document.body.classList.remove('portrait-mode', 'layout-portrait');
const root = document.documentElement;
const wrapper = document.getElementById('app-wrapper');
const qContainer = document.getElementById('questions-container');

const mainNameEl = document.getElementById('main-fullname-input');
const mainClassEl = document.getElementById('main-class-input');
const mainNameWrapper = document.getElementById('main-fullname-wrapper');
const mainClassWrapper = document.getElementById('main-class-wrapper');

if (!isStudentMode && mainNameEl && mainClassEl && mainNameWrapper && mainClassWrapper) {
savedPrintHeaderState = {
nameVal: mainNameEl.value,
classVal: mainClassEl.value,
namePlaceholder: mainNameEl.placeholder,
classHidden: mainClassWrapper.classList.contains('hidden'),
nameFullSpan: mainNameWrapper.classList.contains('col-span-12')
};
mainNameEl.value = '';
mainClassEl.value = '';
mainClassWrapper.classList.remove('hidden');
mainNameWrapper.classList.remove('col-span-12');
mainNameWrapper.classList.add('col-span-8');
}

if (isStudentMode && !hasStartedQuiz && questionsData.length > 0) {
renderQuestionsUI();
}

if (wrapper) wrapper.style.transform = 'none';
if (qContainer) {
qContainer.scrollTop = 0;
qContainer.style.zoom = '1';
}
window.scrollTo(0, 0);

const pCount = activePalette.length;
root.style.setProperty('--print-legend-font', pCount > 12 ? '9px' : (pCount > 9 ? '10px' : '11px'));

document.documentElement.classList.add('printing-a4');
document.body.classList.add('printing-a4');

if (qContainer && questionsData.length > 0) {
qContainer.scrollTop = 0;
qContainer.classList.add('measuring-print');

const availHeight = qContainer.clientHeight;
const safeMaxHeight = availHeight * 0.95;
const startStepIdx = questionsData.length >= 10 ? 1 : 0;

for (let i = startStepIdx; i < PRINT_PRESET_STEPS.length; i++) {
applyPrintPresetStep(PRINT_PRESET_STEPS[i]);
const naturalHeight = measureQuestionsNaturalHeight(qContainer);
if (naturalHeight <= safeMaxHeight) {
break;
}
}

const finalNaturalHeight = measureQuestionsNaturalHeight(qContainer);
if (finalNaturalHeight > safeMaxHeight && availHeight > 0) {
const ratio = Math.max(0.42, safeMaxHeight / finalNaturalHeight);
qContainer.style.zoom = ratio.toFixed(3);
}

qContainer.classList.remove('measuring-print');
qContainer.scrollTop = 0;
}
}

function cleanupPrintLayout() {
if (!isPrintingMode) return;
isPrintingMode = false;
if (isStudentMode && !hasStartedQuiz && questionsData.length > 0) {
renderQuestionsUI();
}

if (savedPrintHeaderState) {
const mainNameEl = document.getElementById('main-fullname-input');
const mainClassEl = document.getElementById('main-class-input');
const mainNameWrapper = document.getElementById('main-fullname-wrapper');
const mainClassWrapper = document.getElementById('main-class-wrapper');

if (mainNameEl) mainNameEl.value = savedPrintHeaderState.nameVal;
if (mainClassEl) mainClassEl.value = savedPrintHeaderState.classVal;
if (mainClassWrapper) {
if (savedPrintHeaderState.classHidden) {
mainClassWrapper.classList.add('hidden');
} else {
mainClassWrapper.classList.remove('hidden');
}
}
if (mainNameWrapper) {
if (savedPrintHeaderState.nameFullSpan) {
mainNameWrapper.classList.remove('col-span-8');
mainNameWrapper.classList.add('col-span-12');
} else {
mainNameWrapper.classList.remove('col-span-12');
mainNameWrapper.classList.add('col-span-8');
}
}
savedPrintHeaderState = null;
}

const qContainer = document.getElementById('questions-container');
if (qContainer) {
qContainer.classList.remove('measuring-print');
qContainer.style.zoom = '';
}
document.documentElement.classList.remove('printing-a4');
document.body.classList.remove('printing-a4');
resizeApp();
}

window.addEventListener('beforeprint', preparePrintLayout);
window.addEventListener('afterprint', cleanupPrintLayout);

function exportPDF() {
preparePrintLayout();
setTimeout(() => {
window.print();
window.addEventListener('mousemove', cleanupPrintLayout, { once: true });
window.addEventListener('touchstart', cleanupPrintLayout, { once: true });
window.addEventListener('keydown', cleanupPrintLayout, { once: true });
window.addEventListener('focus', cleanupPrintLayout, { once: true });
}, 60);
}

activeGridChars = null;

document.getElementById('edit-subject').value = 'Hóa học';

editorDraftQuestions = makeDefaultDrafts();
}

renderEditorForm();

// [CODE15] Đề nằm trong thư mục thì môn học theo thư mục
const subjSel = document.getElementById('edit-subject');
const targetFolder = editorTargetFolderId ? getFolderById(editorTargetFolderId) : null;
if (subjSel) {
if (targetFolder) {
subjSel.value = targetFolder.subject;
subjSel.disabled = true;
subjSel.title = 'Đề thi nằm trong thư mục nên môn học theo thư mục';
} else {
subjSel.disabled = false;
subjSel.title = '';
}
}

try { if (window.CODE153) CODE153.refresh(); } catch (e) {} // [CODE153] đồng bộ tên bài từ NGÂN HÀNG ĐỀ
modal.classList.remove('hidden');
setTimeout(() => { modal.classList.remove('opacity-0'); }, 10);
}

function closeEditor() {
try { if (window.__bankCtx) bankEditorClosed(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } // [CODE138] quay lại danh sách bài
const modal = document.getElementById('editor-modal');
try { const se = document.getElementById('quiz-subtitle'); if (se && !questionsData.length) se.textContent = ''; } catch (e) {} /* [CODE109] */
modal.classList.add('opacity-0');

}

function syncTopicTitleLive(val) {
const subtitleEl = document.getElementById('quiz-subtitle');
/* [CODE109] Chỉ cập nhật tiêu đề đầu trang khi đang có đề mở; soạn đề mới thì KHÔNG ghi tiêu đề lên trang chủ */
if (subtitleEl && questionsData.length > 0) {
subtitleEl.textContent = (val || '').trim() || 'CHỦ ĐỀ BÀI HỌC';
}
}

// ============================================================
// [CODE17] TRÌNH SOẠN CÂU HỎI: 3 dạng câu hỏi
// ============================================================
function makeBlankDraft(type = 'mc') {
return {
type: (type === 'tf' || type === 'sa') ? type : 'mc',
text: '',
options: [{ text: '' }, { text: '' }, { text: '' }, { text: '' }],
correctIndex: 0,
tf: [false, false, false, false],
answer: '',
pts: '',
tfPts: ['', '', '', ''],
solution: '',
tfSol: ['', '', '', '']
};
}

function ensureDraftShape(d) {
const out = d || makeBlankDraft('mc');
out.type = qType(out);
if (!Array.isArray(out.options)) out.options = [];
while (out.options.length < 4) out.options.push({ text: '' });
if (!Array.isArray(out.tf)) out.tf = [false, false, false, false];
while (out.tf.length < 4) out.tf.push(false);
if (!Array.isArray(out.tfPts)) out.tfPts = ['', '', '', ''];
while (out.tfPts.length < 4) out.tfPts.push('');
if (out.pts == null) out.pts = '';
if (typeof out.solution !== 'string') out.solution = out.solution == null ? '' : String(out.solution);
if (!Array.isArray(out.tfSol)) out.tfSol = ['', '', '', ''];
while (out.tfSol.length < 4) out.tfSol.push('');
if (typeof out.answer !== 'string') out.answer = out.answer == null ? '' : String(out.answer);
if (typeof out.text !== 'string') out.text = out.text == null ? '' : String(out.text);
if (out.ginfo != null && typeof out.ginfo !== 'string') out.ginfo = String(out.ginfo);
if (out.level && !/^(NB|TH|VD|VDC)$/.test(out.level)) delete out.level; // [CODE138]
out.correctIndex = out.correctIndex || 0;
return out;
}

// [CODE33] Chuẩn hóa nhóm: mỗi nhóm cùng 1 phần; dữ kiện nằm ở câu đầu tiên của nhóm
function normalizeDraftGroups(list) {
const byGid = {};
list.forEach(q => { if (q.gid) (byGid[q.gid] = byGid[q.gid] || []).push(q); });
Object.keys(byGid).forEach(gid => {
const mem = byGid[gid];
const cnt = {};
mem.forEach(q => { const t = qType(q); cnt[t] = (cnt[t] || 0) + 1; });
const bestT = Object.keys(cnt).sort((a, b) => cnt[b] - cnt[a])[0];
let info = '';
mem.forEach(q => { if (!info && q.ginfo && String(q.ginfo).trim()) info = q.ginfo; });
const keep = mem.filter(q => qType(q) === bestT);
mem.forEach(q => { if (qType(q) !== bestT) { delete q.gid; delete q.ginfo; } });
keep.forEach((q, i) => { if (i === 0) { if (info) q.ginfo = info; } else delete q.ginfo; });
});
return list;
}
function groupFieldsFromDraft(d) {
if (!d || !d.gid) return {};
const info = String(d.ginfo || '').trim();
return { gid: String(d.gid), ...(info ? { ginfo: info } : {}), ...(d.gm ? { gm: String(d.gm) } : {}) };
}
function editorUngroup(idx) {
syncEditorDOMToDraft();
const d = editorDraftQuestions[idx];
if (!d || !d.gid) return;
const gid = d.gid;
editorDraftQuestions.forEach(q => { if (q.gid === gid) { delete q.gid; delete q.ginfo; delete q.gm; } });
renderEditorForm();
}
// [CODE121] Chọn dạng nhóm English: '' = cố định | 'k' = giữ số câu (Read the) | 's' = đảo cả câu và đáp án
function editorSetGroupMode(idx, val) {
syncEditorDOMToDraft();
const d = editorDraftQuestions[idx];
if (!d || !d.gid) return;
editorDraftQuestions.forEach(q => { if (q.gid === d.gid) { if (val) q.gm = val; else delete q.gm; } });
renderEditorForm();
}
function editorJoinPrevGroup(idx) {
syncEditorDOMToDraft();
const d = editorDraftQuestions[idx], p = editorDraftQuestions[idx - 1];
if (!d || !p || qType(d) !== qType(p) || d.gid) return;
if (!p.gid) p.gid = 'g_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
d.gid = p.gid;
if (p.gm) d.gm = p.gm;
renderEditorForm();
}

function sortDraftsByType(list) {
return list
.map((q, i) => ({ q, i }))
.sort((a, b) => (PART_ORDER[qType(a.q)] - PART_ORDER[qType(b.q)]) || (a.i - b.i))
.map(x => x.q);
}

function topicQuestionToDraft(q) {
const t = qType(q);
const d = makeBlankDraft(t);
d.text = q.text || '';
d.solution = String(q.solution || '');
d.tfSol = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => String((q.tfSol && q.tfSol[i]) || ''));
if (t === 'tf') {
d.options = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => ({ text: (q.options && q.options[i] && q.options[i].text) || '' }));
d.tf = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => Boolean(q.tfAnswers && q.tfAnswers[i]));
d.tfPts = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => (q.tfPts && _num(q.tfPts[i]) > 0) ? _num(q.tfPts[i]) : '');
} else if (t === 'sa') {
d.answer = String(q.shortAnswer == null ? '' : q.shortAnswer);
d.pts = _num(q.pts) > 0 ? _num(q.pts) : '';
} else {
d.pts = _num(q.pts) > 0 ? _num(q.pts) : '';
d.options = (q.options || []).map(o => ({ text: o.text }));
d.correctIndex = Math.max(0, (q.options || []).findIndex(opt => opt.letter === q.correct));
}
if (q.gid) d.gid = String(q.gid);
if (q.ginfo) d.ginfo = String(q.ginfo);
if (q.gm) d.gm = String(q.gm); // [CODE121]
if (q.level) d.level = q.level; // [CODE138]
if (q.bankUid) { d.bankUid = q.bankUid; if (q.bankKey) d.bankKey = q.bankKey; } // [CODE164]
return ensureDraftShape(d);
}

function makeDefaultDrafts() {
// Mặc định: 6 câu Phần I + 2 câu Phần II + 2 câu Phần III
return [
...Array.from({ length: 6 }, () => makeBlankDraft('mc')),
...Array.from({ length: 2 }, () => makeBlankDraft('tf')),
...Array.from({ length: 2 }, () => makeBlankDraft('sa'))
];
}

function syncEditorDOMToDraft() {
editorDraftQuestions.forEach((draft, idx) => {
ensureDraftShape(draft);
const qInput = document.getElementById(`edit-q-text-${idx}`);
if (qInput) draft.text = imgUnmask(draft, qInput.value);
const lvSel = document.getElementById(`edit-q-level-${idx}`); // [CODE138]
if (lvSel) { if (lvSel.value) draft.level = lvSel.value; else delete draft.level; }
const giInput = document.getElementById(`edit-q-ginfo-${idx}`);
if (giInput) draft.ginfo = imgUnmask(draft, giInput.value);

for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
const optInput = document.getElementById(`edit-q-${idx}-opt-${j}`);
if (optInput) draft.options[j].text = optInput.value;
}

const checkedRadio = document.querySelector(`input[name="edit-q-correct-${idx}"]:checked`);
if (checkedRadio) draft.correctIndex = parseInt(checkedRadio.value, 10);

for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
const r = document.querySelector(`input[name="edit-q-tf-${idx}-${j}"]:checked`);
if (r) draft.tf[j] = (r.value === '1');
}

const ansInput = document.getElementById(`edit-q-ans-${idx}`);
if (ansInput) draft.answer = ansInput.value;

// [CODE26] lời giải
const solInput = document.getElementById(`edit-q-sol-${idx}`);
if (solInput) draft.solution = solInput.value;
for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
const ts = document.getElementById(`edit-q-tfsol-${idx}-${j}`);
if (ts) draft.tfSol[j] = ts.value;
}

// [CODE20] điểm thủ công
const ptsInput = document.getElementById(`edit-q-pts-${idx}`);
if (ptsInput) draft.pts = ptsInput.value;
for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
const yi = document.getElementById(`edit-q-typts-${idx}-${j}`);
if (yi) draft.tfPts[j] = yi.value;
}
});
}

function changeEditorQuestionType(idx, newType) {
syncEditorDOMToDraft();
const d = editorDraftQuestions[idx];
if (!d) return;
d.type = (newType === 'tf' || newType === 'sa') ? newType : 'mc';
d._flash = true;
renderEditorForm();
}

// ============================================================
// [CODE18] CHIA ĐIỂM & ĐỔI THỨ TỰ – phần cài đặt trong trình soạn đề
// ============================================================
function readEditorScoring() {
const out = {};
let any = false;
['mc', 'tf', 'sa'].forEach(t => {
const el = document.getElementById('edit-pts-' + t);
const v = el ? parseFloat(String(el.value).replace(',', '.')) : NaN;
if (isFinite(v) && v > 0) { out[t] = v; any = true; } else out[t] = null;
});
const ty = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(j => { const el = document.getElementById('edit-ty-' + j); return el ? _num(el.value) : 0; });
if (ty.some(v => v > 0)) { out.ty = ty; any = true; }
const tiers = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(j => { const el = document.getElementById('edit-tier-' + j); return el ? _num(el.value) : 0; });
if (!out.ty && tiers.some(v => v > 0)) { out.tiers = tiers; any = true; }
return any ? out : null;
}
function fillTyEqual() {
const subject = (document.getElementById('edit-subject') || {}).value || '';
const list = (editorDraftQuestions || []).map(d => ({ type: qType(d) }));
const counts = countByType(list);
const entered = readEditorScoring();
if (entered) { delete entered.ty; delete entered.tiers; }
const totals = computeEffectiveTotals(counts, entered, subject);
const perQ = counts.tf > 0 ? totals.tf / counts.tf : 1;
const each = Math.round(perQ / 4 * 1000) / 1000;
[0, 1, 2, 3].forEach(j => { const el = document.getElementById('edit-ty-' + j); if (el) el.value = each; });
[0, 1, 2, 3].forEach(j => { const el = document.getElementById('edit-tier-' + j); if (el) el.value = ''; });
refreshScoringSummary();
}
// [CODE22] Điểm 1 câu Phần II khi đúng 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 ý
function fillTierStandard() {
const subject = (document.getElementById('edit-subject') || {}).value || '';
const counts = countByType((editorDraftQuestions || []).map(d => ({ type: qType(d) })));
const entered = readEditorScoring();
if (entered) { delete entered.ty; delete entered.tiers; }
const totals = computeEffectiveTotals(counts, entered, subject);
const perQ = counts.tf > 0 ? totals.tf / counts.tf : 1;
[0, 1, 2, 3].forEach(j => {
const el = document.getElementById('edit-tier-' + j);
if (el) el.value = Math.round(perQ * TF_LADDER[j + 1] * 1000) / 1000;
const ty = document.getElementById('edit-ty-' + j); if (ty) ty.value = '';
});
refreshScoringSummary();
}
// Chỉ dùng MỘT cách chia điểm Phần II: theo từng ý (a,b,c,d) HOẶC theo số ý đúng (1/2/3/4)
function scoringExclusive(src) {
const mine = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(j => document.getElementById((src === 'ty' ? 'edit-ty-' : 'edit-tier-') + j));
const other = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(j => document.getElementById((src === 'ty' ? 'edit-tier-' : 'edit-ty-') + j));
if (mine.some(el => el && _num(el.value) > 0)) other.forEach(el => { if (el) el.value = ''; });
refreshScoringSummary();
}
function readEditorShuffle() {
const chk = id => { const el = document.getElementById(id); return Boolean(el && el.checked); };
return {
q: { mc: chk('edit-shq-mc'), tf: chk('edit-shq-tf'), sa: chk('edit-shq-sa') },
o: { mc: chk('edit-sho-mc'), tf: chk('edit-sho-tf') }
};
}
function loadEditorSettings(topic) {
const sc = (topic && topic.scoring) || {};
['mc', 'tf', 'sa'].forEach(t => {
const el = document.getElementById('edit-pts-' + t);
if (el) el.value = (sc[t] != null && sc[t] !== '') ? sc[t] : '';
});
[0, 1, 2, 3].forEach(j => {
const el = document.getElementById('edit-ty-' + j);
const v = Array.isArray(sc.ty) ? _num(sc.ty[j]) : 0;
if (el) el.value = v > 0 ? v : '';
const et = document.getElementById('edit-tier-' + j);
const vt = Array.isArray(sc.tiers) ? _num(sc.tiers[j]) : 0;
if (et) et.value = vt > 0 ? vt : '';
});
// [CODE115] đề mới (hoặc đề chưa từng cấu hình đảo) -> mặc định ĐẢO CÂU HỎI ở cả 3 phần
const sh = (topic && topic.shuffle) || { q: { mc: true, tf: true, sa: true }, o: {} };
const set = (id, v) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.checked = Boolean(v); };
set('edit-shq-mc', sh.q && sh.q.mc); set('edit-shq-tf', sh.q && sh.q.tf); set('edit-shq-sa', sh.q && sh.q.sa);
set('edit-sho-mc', sh.o && sh.o.mc); set('edit-sho-tf', sh.o && sh.o.tf);
}
function refreshScoringSummary() {
const el = document.getElementById('edit-scoring-summary');
if (!el) return;
try { syncEditorDOMToDraft(); } catch (e) {}
const subject = (document.getElementById('edit-subject') || {}).value || '';
const entered = readEditorScoring();
const list = (editorDraftQuestions || []).map(d => ({ type: qType(d), pts: d.pts, tfPts: d.tfPts }));
const counts = countByType(list);
const per = computePartPer(list, entered, subject);
const names = { mc: 'Phần I', tf: 'Phần II', sa: 'Phần III' };
const parts = [];
let sum = 0;
['mc', 'tf', 'sa'].forEach(t => {
if (!counts[t]) return;
const group = list.filter(q => qType(q) === t);
const partMax = group.reduce((acc, q) => acc + maxPointsFor(q, per, entered), 0);
const ownN = group.filter(hasOwnPoints).length;
const manual = (entered && entered[t] != null) || ownN > 0 || (t === 'tf' && Boolean(tfYPointsOf({}, entered) || tfTiersOf(entered)));
sum += partMax;
let txt = `<b>${names[t]}</b>: ${counts[t]} câu = <b>${fmtPoints(partMax)}</b> điểm ${manual ? '' : '<i>(tự động)</i>'}`;
if (ownN) txt += ` <i>(${ownN} câu có điểm riêng)</i>`;
if (t === 'tf') {
const ty = tfYPointsOf({}, entered);
const trS = tfTiersOf(entered);
if (ty) txt += ` [mỗi ý: a ${fmtPoints(ty[0])} / b ${fmtPoints(ty[1])} / c ${fmtPoints(ty[2])} / d ${fmtPoints(ty[3])}]`;
else if (trS) txt += ` [mỗi câu, đúng 1/2/3/4 ý: ${fmtPoints(trS[0])} / ${fmtPoints(trS[1])} / ${fmtPoints(trS[2])} / ${fmtPoints(trS[3])}]`;
else txt += ` [đúng 1/2/3/4 ý: ${fmtPoints(per.tf * TF_LADDER[1])} / ${fmtPoints(per.tf * TF_LADDER[2])} / ${fmtPoints(per.tf * TF_LADDER[3])} / ${fmtPoints(per.tf)}]`;
}
parts.push(txt);
});
let html = parts.join(' &nbsp;•&nbsp; ') || 'Chưa có câu hỏi.';
html += ` &nbsp;|&nbsp; Tổng: <b>${fmtPoints(sum)}</b> điểm`;
if (Math.abs(sum - 10) > 0.01 && sum > 0) html += ' <span class="text-red-600">⚠ Tổng khác 10 – khi chấm sẽ được quy về thang 10.</span>';
el.innerHTML = html;
}
function autoFillScoring() {
const subject = (document.getElementById('edit-subject') || {}).value || '';
const totals = computeEffectiveTotals(countByType(editorDraftQuestions || []), null, subject);
['mc', 'tf', 'sa'].forEach(t => {
const el = document.getElementById('edit-pts-' + t);
if (el) el.value = totals[t] > 0 ? totals[t] : '';
});
refreshScoringSummary();
}
function clearScoring() {
['mc', 'tf', 'sa'].forEach(t => { const el = document.getElementById('edit-pts-' + t); if (el) el.value = ''; });
[0, 1, 2, 3].forEach(j => { const el = document.getElementById('edit-ty-' + j); if (el) el.value = ''; });
[0, 1, 2, 3].forEach(j => { const el = document.getElementById('edit-tier-' + j); if (el) el.value = ''; });
refreshScoringSummary();
}

function renderEditorForm() {
const container = document.getElementById('editor-questions-container');
const badge = document.getElementById('editor-q-count-badge');
if (!container) return;

editorDraftQuestions = sortDraftsByType(editorDraftQuestions.map(ensureDraftShape));
normalizeDraftGroups(editorDraftQuestions);
// [CODE33] số câu (theo từng phần) của mỗi nhóm để hiển thị
const grpNums = {};
{
const cc = { mc: 0, tf: 0, sa: 0 };
editorDraftQuestions.forEach(q => { const t = qType(q); cc[t]++; if (q.gid) (grpNums[q.gid] = grpNums[q.gid] || []).push(cc[t]); });
}
const cnt = countByType(editorDraftQuestions);
if (badge) badge.textContent = `${editorDraftQuestions.length} câu • I: ${cnt.mc} • II: ${cnt.tf} • III: ${cnt.sa}`;
container.innerHTML = '';

const counters = { mc: 0, tf: 0, sa: 0 };
let lastT = null;
let flashIdx = -1;

editorDraftQuestions.forEach((q, idx) => {
const t = qType(q);
const meta = PART_META[t];
if (t !== lastT) {
const head = document.createElement('div');
head.className = `bg-gradient-to-r ${meta.soft} border-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap`;
head.innerHTML = `
<span class="${meta.badge} text-white font-black rounded-full px-3 py-0.5 text-sm">PHẦN ${meta.roman}</span>
<span class="font-black text-sm">${_escHtml(meta.title)}</span>
<span class="text-xs font-black opacity-70">(${cnt[t]} câu)</span>`;
container.appendChild(head);
lastT = t;
}
counters[t]++;
if (q._flash) { flashIdx = idx; delete q._flash; }

const card = document.createElement('div');
card.id = `edit-q-card-${idx}`;
card.className = 'bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm relative';

const allTexts = [q.text, q.answer].concat((q.options || []).map(o => o.text || ''));
const hasFormula = allTexts.some(s => /\$|\\|<(?:sub|sup)>/i.test(s || ''));
let previewHtml = '';
if (hasFormula) {
let body = '';
if (t === 'mc') {
body = `<div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-2 pt-1">${[0, 1, 2, 3].map(o => `<div class="bg-white px-2 py-1 rounded border border-indigo-100 font-bold"><span class="text-indigo-700 font-black">${'ABCD'[o]}.</span> ${formatMathAndChemHTML(q.options[o]?.text || '')}</div>`).join('')}</div>`;
} else if (t === 'tf') {
body = `<div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1 pt-1">${[0, 1, 2, 3].map(o => `<div class="bg-white px-2 py-1 rounded border border-indigo-100 font-bold"><span class="text-indigo-700 font-black">${'abcd'[o]})</span> ${formatMathAndChemHTML(q.options[o]?.text || '')} <b class="${q.tf[o] ? 'text-emerald-700' : 'text-red-600'}">[${q.tf[o] ? 'Đúng' : 'Sai'}]</b></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
} else {
body = `<div class="bg-white px-2 py-1 rounded border border-indigo-100 font-bold">Trả lời: ${formatMathAndChemHTML(q.answer || '')}</div>`;
}
previewHtml = `
<div class="mt-2.5 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-50/70 border border-indigo-200 text-xs text-slate-800 space-y-1">
<div class="font-black text-indigo-900">👁️ Xem trước hiển thị công thức: <span class="font-bold text-slate-900">${formatMathAndChemHTML(q.text)}</span></div>
${body}
</div>`;
}

let bodyHtml = '';
if (t === 'mc') {
bodyHtml = `
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
${[0, 1, 2, 3].map(optIdx => `
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-50 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
<input type="radio" name="edit-q-correct-${idx}" value="${optIdx}" ${q.correctIndex === optIdx ? 'checked' : ''} class="w-4 h-4 accent-emerald-600 cursor-pointer" title="Chọn làm đáp án đúng">
<span class="text-xs font-black text-slate-500">${'ABCD'[optIdx]}.</span>
<input type="text" id="edit-q-${idx}-opt-${optIdx}" value="${impEsc(q.options[optIdx]?.text || '')}" class="w-full bg-transparent border-b border-slate-300 focus:border-emerald-600 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 px-1" placeholder="Đáp án ${'ABCD'[optIdx]}...">
</div>`).join('')}
</div>`;
} else if (t === 'tf') {
bodyHtml = `
<div class="space-y-2">
${[0, 1, 2, 3].map(j => `
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-50 p-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 flex-wrap">
<span class="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">${'abcd'[j]}</span>
<input type="text" id="edit-q-${idx}-opt-${j}" value="${impEsc(q.options[j]?.text || '')}" class="flex-1 min-w-[180px] bg-transparent border-b border-slate-300 focus:border-emerald-600 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 px-1" placeholder="Nội dung ý ${'abcd'[j]})...">
<label class="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-black text-emerald-700 cursor-pointer"><input type="radio" name="edit-q-tf-${idx}-${j}" value="1" ${q.tf[j] ? 'checked' : ''} class="accent-emerald-600"> Đúng</label>
<label class="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-black text-red-600 cursor-pointer"><input type="radio" name="edit-q-tf-${idx}-${j}" value="0" ${!q.tf[j] ? 'checked' : ''} class="accent-red-600"> Sai</label>
<label class="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-black text-amber-800" title="Điểm riêng của ý này (để trống = dùng cài đặt chung)">Điểm <input type="number" min="0" step="0.05" inputmode="decimal" id="edit-q-typts-${idx}-${j}" value="${impEsc(String(q.tfPts && q.tfPts[j] != null ? q.tfPts[j] : ''))}" oninput="refreshScoringSummary()" placeholder="—" class="w-16 bg-white border border-amber-300 rounded-lg px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-amber-600"></label>
</div>`).join('')}
</div>`;
} else {
const empty = !String(q.answer || '').trim();
const tooLong = String(q.answer || '').trim().length > 4;
bodyHtml = `
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg border flex-wrap ${empty ? 'bg-red-50 border-red-300' : 'bg-orange-50 border-orange-200'}">
<span class="text-sm font-black text-orange-800">Trả lời:</span>
<input type="text" id="edit-q-ans-${idx}" value="${impEsc(q.answer || '')}" placeholder="VD: 12,5" class="w-36 text-center bg-white border border-orange-300 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-base font-black text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-orange-600">
<span class="text-xs font-bold ${empty || tooLong ? 'text-red-600' : 'text-slate-500'}">${empty ? '⚠ Chưa có đáp án' : (tooLong ? '⚠ Đáp án dài hơn 4 ký tự' : '(tối đa 4 ký tự: số, dấu âm, dấu phẩy)')}</span>
</div>`;
}

// [CODE26] Ô nhập lời giải (Phần II: theo từng ý a, b, c, d)
let solHtml = '';
const solTa = 'w-full bg-white border border-amber-300 rounded-lg p-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-amber-600';
if (t === 'tf') {
solHtml = `
<div class="mt-3 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 space-y-2">
<div class="text-xs font-black text-amber-900 uppercase">💡 Lời giải từng ý (hiện trong nút “Xem hướng dẫn” sau khi nộp bài)</div>
${[0, 1, 2, 3].map(j => `
<div class="flex items-start gap-2">
<span class="w-6 h-6 mt-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">${'abcd'[j]}</span>
<textarea id="edit-q-tfsol-${idx}-${j}" rows="2" class="${solTa}" placeholder="Giải thích ý ${'abcd'[j]}) (hỗ trợ công thức $...$)...">${impEsc(q.tfSol[j] || '')}</textarea>
</div>`).join('')}
${String(q.solution || '').trim() ? `<textarea id="edit-q-sol-${idx}" rows="2" class="${solTa}" placeholder="Lời giải chung...">${impEsc(q.solution)}</textarea>` : ''}
</div>`;
} else {
solHtml = `
<div class="mt-3 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200">
<label class="block text-xs font-black text-amber-900 uppercase mb-1">💡 Lời giải / Hướng dẫn (hiện trong nút “Xem hướng dẫn” sau khi nộp bài)</label>
<textarea id="edit-q-sol-${idx}" rows="3" class="${solTa}" placeholder="Nhập lời giải (hỗ trợ công thức $...$). Để trống = câu này không có nút Xem hướng dẫn.">${impEsc(q.solution || '')}</textarea>
</div>`;
}

// [CODE33] Khối nhóm câu hỏi
let groupHtml = '';
if (q.gid) {
const nums = grpNums[q.gid] || [];
const rangeTxt = nums.length > 1 ? `${nums[0]} – ${nums[nums.length - 1]}` : String(nums[0] || '');
const isLeader = idx === editorDraftQuestions.findIndex(x => x.gid === q.gid);
groupHtml = isLeader ? `
<div class="mb-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border-2 border-rose-300">
<div class="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 mb-1.5">
<div class="text-xs font-black text-rose-800 uppercase">🔗 Nhóm câu hỏi: ${GROUP_HEAD_TEXT} ${rangeTxt}:</div>
<button type="button" onclick="editorUngroup(${idx})" class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-black text-rose-700 bg-white hover:bg-rose-100 border border-rose-300">Bỏ nhóm</button>
</div>
<textarea id="edit-q-ginfo-${idx}" rows="4" class="w-full bg-white border border-rose-300 rounded-lg p-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-rose-600" placeholder="Thông tin / dữ kiện dùng chung cho các câu trong nhóm (hỗ trợ công thức $...$)...">${impEsc(imgMask(q, q.ginfo || ''))}</textarea>
<div class="text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-700 mt-1">Các câu trong nhóm được cố định, không bị xáo thứ tự; số câu trong dòng tiêu đề tự cập nhật khi hiển thị cho học sinh.</div>
<div class="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap text-[11px] font-black text-rose-800">
<span>📘 Dạng nhóm (English):</span>
<select onchange="editorSetGroupMode(${idx}, this.value)" class="bg-white border border-rose-300 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-[12px] font-black text-slate-800 outline-none">
<option value="" ${!q.gm ? 'selected' : ''}>Mặc định – cố định cả nhóm</option>
<option value="k" ${q.gm === 'k' ? 'selected' : ''}>Dạng 1 (Read the…) – giữ số câu, chỉ đảo đáp án A-B-C-D</option>
<option value="s" ${q.gm === 's' ? 'selected' : ''}>Dạng 2 – đảo cả thứ tự câu và đáp án</option>
</select>
</div>
</div>` : `
<div class="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap text-[11px] font-black text-rose-700">
<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-100 border border-rose-300">🔗 Thuộc nhóm câu ${rangeTxt} (dùng dữ kiện ở câu đầu nhóm)</span>
<button type="button" onclick="editorUngroup(${idx})" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white hover:bg-rose-100 border border-rose-300">Bỏ nhóm</button>
</div>`;
}
const prevQ = idx > 0 ? editorDraftQuestions[idx - 1] : null;
const canJoin = !q.gid && prevQ && qType(prevQ) === t;
const joinBtn = canJoin ? `<button type="button" onclick="editorJoinPrevGroup(${idx})" title="Ghép câu này vào cùng nhóm với câu liền trước (dùng chung dữ kiện, cố định vị trí)" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-black text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 border border-rose-200 transition-colors">🔗 Ghép nhóm với câu trước</button>` : '';

card.innerHTML = `
<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-2 flex-wrap gap-2">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2">
<span class="w-7 h-7 rounded-full ${meta.badge} text-white font-black text-sm flex items-center justify-center shadow-sm">${counters[t]}</span>
<span class="font-black text-slate-800 text-sm">Phần ${meta.roman} • Câu ${counters[t]}:</span>
</div>
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
${editorLevelSelectHtml(idx, q)}${t === 'tf' ? '' : `<label class="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-black text-amber-800" title="Điểm riêng của câu này (để trống = dùng cài đặt chung của phần)">Điểm câu <input type="number" min="0" step="0.05" inputmode="decimal" id="edit-q-pts-${idx}" value="${impEsc(String(q.pts == null ? '' : q.pts))}" oninput="refreshScoringSummary()" placeholder="Tự động" class="w-20 bg-white border border-amber-300 rounded-lg px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-black text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-amber-600"></label>`}
<select id="edit-q-type-${idx}" onchange="changeEditorQuestionType(${idx}, this.value)" class="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs font-black text-slate-700 outline-none cursor-pointer" title="Đổi dạng câu hỏi">
<option value="mc" ${t === 'mc' ? 'selected' : ''}>Phần I – Nhiều lựa chọn</option>
<option value="tf" ${t === 'tf' ? 'selected' : ''}>Phần II – Đúng / Sai</option>
<option value="sa" ${t === 'sa' ? 'selected' : ''}>Phần III – Trả lời ngắn</option>
</select>
${joinBtn}
<button type="button" onclick="removeEditorQuestion(${idx})" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-black text-red-600 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 border border-red-200 transition-colors">
🗑 Xóa câu này
</button>
</div>
</div>
${groupHtml}
<textarea id="edit-q-text-${idx}" rows="${Math.min(10, Math.max(2, String(q.text || '').split('\n').length))}" class="w-full border border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 mb-3" placeholder="Nhập nội dung câu hỏi (hỗ trợ công thức $...$, H<sub>2</sub>O, x<sup>2</sup>)...">${impEsc(imgMask(q, q.text))}</textarea>
${bodyHtml}
${solHtml}
${previewHtml}
`;
container.appendChild(card);
});

refreshScoringSummary();

if (flashIdx >= 0) {
const el = document.getElementById(`edit-q-card-${flashIdx}`);
if (el) {
el.classList.add('ring-4', 'ring-emerald-300');
setTimeout(() => el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' }), 30);
setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('ring-4', 'ring-emerald-300'), 1800);
}
}
}

function addEditorQuestion(type = 'mc') {
syncEditorDOMToDraft();
const d = makeBlankDraft(type);
d._flash = true;
editorDraftQuestions.push(d);
syncPaletteAndPatternToCount(editorDraftQuestions.length);
renderEditorForm();
}

// ============================================================
// [CODE17] XEM TRƯỚC / CHỈNH SỬA / NẠP – 3 DẠNG CÂU HỎI (Word & PDF)
// ============================================================
function renderImportPreview(kind) {
const draft = getImportDraft(kind);
const listEl = document.getElementById(`${kind}-preview-list`);
const badgeEl = document.getElementById(`${kind}-preview-badge`);
const reportEl = document.getElementById(`${kind}-import-report`);
if (!listEl) return;

const T = kind === 'pdf'
? { title: 'text-rose-800', on: 'bg-rose-600 text-yellow-300 border-rose-700', dot: 'bg-yellow-300 text-rose-950' }
: { title: 'text-blue-800', on: 'bg-emerald-600 text-yellow-300 border-emerald-700', dot: 'bg-yellow-300 text-emerald-900' };
const optLabels = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'];
const resolved = draft.filter(q => q.detectedByStyle).length;
const unresolved = draft.length - resolved;
const cnt = countByType(draft);
const counters = { mc: 0, tf: 0, sa: 0 };

if (badgeEl) {
badgeEl.textContent = `${draft.length} câu • I: ${cnt.mc} • II: ${cnt.tf} • III: ${cnt.sa} (${resolved} đã có đáp án)`;
}

if (reportEl) {
const rep = draft.report || { skipped: [], warnings: [] };
let html = '';
if (draft.length > 0 && unresolved > 0) {
html += `<p>⚠ <b>${unresolved}</b> câu chưa xác định được đáp án đúng. Phần I: bấm A/B/C/D (hoặc “Nhập nhanh đáp án”); Phần II: bấm Đúng/Sai ở từng ý; Phần III: nhập đáp án vào ô “Trả lời”.</p>`;
}
(rep.warnings || []).forEach(w => {
const info = /^Đã nhận diện/.test(w);
html += `<p>${info ? 'ℹ️' : '⚠'} ${impEsc(w)}</p>`;
});
if ((rep.skipped || []).length > 0) {
html += `<details class="mt-1"><summary class="cursor-pointer font-black">Xem ${rep.skipped.length} khối chưa nạp được</summary><ul class="list-disc pl-5 mt-1 space-y-0.5">${rep.skipped.slice(0, 30).map(s => `<li>${impEsc(s)}…</li>`).join('')}</ul></details>`;
}
reportEl.innerHTML = html;
reportEl.classList.toggle('hidden', !html);
}

if (draft.length === 0) {
const hint = kind === 'pdf'
? 'Hãy nhấn chọn file PDF (.pdf) ở khung bên trái để hệ thống tự động tách câu hỏi.'
: 'Hãy tải file Word (.docx) hoặc dán nội dung ở khung bên trái để hệ thống xử lý và hiển thị tại đây.';
listEl.innerHTML = `
<div class="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center text-slate-400 p-6">
<p class="text-sm font-black uppercase mb-1">Chưa có câu hỏi nào ở màn hình kiểm tra</p>
<p class="text-xs font-bold">${hint}</p>
</div>`;
return;
}

listEl.innerHTML = '';
draft.forEach((q, qIdx) => {
const t = qType(q);
counters[t]++;
const meta = PART_META[t];
const opts = q.options || [];
const emptyOpt = t !== 'sa' && opts.some(o => !o.text || !o.text.trim() || o.text.trim() === '...');
const needsReview = !q.detectedByStyle || emptyOpt;
const card = document.createElement('div');
card.className = 'bg-white p-3 rounded-xl border shadow-sm ' + (needsReview ? 'border-amber-300' : 'border-slate-200');

let statusBadge;
if (t === 'tf') {
const trueList = (q.tfAnswers || []).map((v, j) => v ? 'abcd'[j] : null).filter(Boolean);
statusBadge = q.detectedByStyle
? `<span class="text-[11px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">✓ Ý đúng: ${trueList.length ? trueList.join(', ') : '(không có)'}</span>`
: `<span class="text-[11px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">⚠ Chưa thấy ý đúng (bấm Đúng/Sai)</span>`;
} else if (t === 'sa') {
const len = String(q.shortAnswer || '').length;
statusBadge = q.detectedByStyle
? `<span class="text-[11px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${len > 4 ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'}">${len > 4 ? '⚠ Dài hơn 4 ký tự:' : '✓ Trả lời:'} ${impEsc(q.shortAnswer)}</span>`
: `<span class="text-[11px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">⚠ Chưa có đáp án (nhập ô Trả lời)</span>`;
} else {
statusBadge = q.detectedByStyle
? `<span class="text-[11px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">✓ Đáp án ${optLabels[q.correctIndex]}${q.weakStyle ? ' (suy đoán theo chữ đậm)' : ''}</span>`
: `<span class="text-[11px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">⚠ Chưa có đáp án (Click chọn)</span>`;
}
const emptyBadge = emptyOpt
? `<span class="text-[11px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-red-100 text-red-700">⚠ Phương án trống</span>`
: '';

const hasSolImp = Boolean(String(q.solution || '').trim()) || (Array.isArray(q.tfSol) && q.tfSol.some(x => String(x || '').trim()));
const solBadgeHtml = (hasSolImp ? `<span class="text-[11px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">📖 Có lời giải</span>` : '') + (q.level ? `<span class="text-[11px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-sky-100 text-sky-800">🎯 ${q.level}</span>` : '');
let answerAreaHtml = '';
if (t === 'mc') {
answerAreaHtml = `<div id="${kind}-prev-opts-${qIdx}" class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5">${opts.map((opt, oIdx) => {
const isCorrect = q.detectedByStyle && q.correctIndex === oIdx;
return `
<button type="button" onclick="setImportCorrect('${kind}', ${qIdx}, ${oIdx})" class="text-left px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${isCorrect ? T.on + ' shadow-sm' : 'bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-200'}">
<span class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-black shrink-0 ${isCorrect ? T.dot : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'}">${optLabels[oIdx]}</span>
<span class="math-content break-words flex-1">${formatMathAndChemHTML(opt.text)}</span>
</button>`;
}).join('')}</div>`;
} else if (t === 'tf') {
answerAreaHtml = `<div id="${kind}-prev-opts-${qIdx}" class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1.5">${opts.map((opt, j) => {
const v = Boolean((q.tfAnswers || [])[j]);
return `
<div class="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg border text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 ${v && q.detectedByStyle ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'}">
<span class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-black shrink-0 bg-slate-200 text-slate-700">${'abcd'[j]}</span>
<span class="math-content break-words flex-1">${formatMathAndChemHTML(opt.text)}</span>
<button type="button" onclick="setImportTF('${kind}', ${qIdx}, ${j}, true)" class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border text-[11px] font-black ${v ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-700' : 'bg-white text-slate-500 border-slate-300 hover:bg-emerald-50'}">Đúng</button>
<button type="button" onclick="setImportTF('${kind}', ${qIdx}, ${j}, false)" class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border text-[11px] font-black ${!v ? 'bg-red-600 text-white border-red-700' : 'bg-white text-slate-500 border-slate-300 hover:bg-red-50'}">Sai</button>
</div>`;
}).join('')}</div>`;
} else {
answerAreaHtml = `
<div class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-orange-50 border border-orange-200 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5">
<span class="text-xs font-black text-orange-800">Trả lời:</span>
<input type="text" value="${impEsc(q.shortAnswer || '')}" oninput="updateImportAnswer('${kind}', ${qIdx}, this.value)" placeholder="VD: 12,5" class="w-32 text-center bg-white border border-orange-300 rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-sm font-black text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-orange-600">
<span class="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500">(tối đa 4 ký tự)</span>
</div>`;
}

const optionsEditHtml = t === 'sa' ? '' : `
<div class="grid ${t === 'tf' ? 'grid-cols-1' : 'grid-cols-2'} gap-1.5">
${opts.map((opt, oIdx) => `
<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-sky-200">
<span class="text-[11px] font-black text-sky-700">${t === 'tf' ? 'abcd'[oIdx] + ')' : optLabels[oIdx] + '.'}</span>
<input type="text" value="${impEsc(imgMask(q, opt.text))}" oninput="updateImportOptionText('${kind}', ${qIdx}, ${oIdx}, this.value)" class="w-full text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 outline-none">
</div>`).join('')}
</div>`;

const editAreaHtml = q.isEditingInPreview ? `
<div class="mt-2.5 pt-2.5 border-t border-sky-200 bg-sky-50/70 p-2.5 rounded-xl space-y-2">
<label class="block text-[11px] font-black text-sky-900 uppercase">Chỉnh sửa nội dung câu hỏi ${qIdx + 1} (Hỗ trợ LaTeX $...$):</label>
<textarea rows="${Math.min(10, Math.max(2, String(q.text || '').split('\n').length))}" oninput="updateImportQuestionText('${kind}', ${qIdx}, this.value)" class="w-full bg-white border border-sky-300 rounded-lg p-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-sky-600">${impEsc(imgMask(q, q.text))}</textarea>
${optionsEditHtml}
<div class="flex justify-end">
<button type="button" onclick="toggleImportEdit('${kind}', ${qIdx})" class="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white text-[11px] font-black uppercase">✓ Xong</button>
</div>
</div>` : '';

card.innerHTML = `
<div class="flex justify-between items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
<span class="text-xs font-black ${T.title} uppercase flex items-center gap-1.5">
<span class="${meta.badge} text-white rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px]">PHẦN ${meta.roman}</span>
Câu ${counters[t]}
</span>
<div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap justify-end">
${emptyBadge}
${solBadgeHtml}
${q.gid ? `<span class="text-[11px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-100 text-rose-800" title="${impEsc(q.ginfo ? 'Dữ kiện chung: ' + String(q.ginfo).replace(/@@(?:IMG|TBL)_[A-Za-z0-9+\/=_-]+(?:~\d+x\d+)?@@/g, '[hình]').slice(0, 300) : 'Câu thuộc nhóm — dùng dữ kiện ở câu đầu nhóm')}">🔗 ${q.ginfo ? 'Câu đầu nhóm (có dữ kiện chung)' : 'Câu trong nhóm'} • cố định</span>` : ''}
${statusBadge}
<button type="button" onclick="toggleImportEdit('${kind}', ${qIdx})" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 hover:bg-sky-100 text-slate-700 hover:text-sky-800 border border-slate-200 text-[11px] font-black transition-colors">${q.isEditingInPreview ? 'Đóng sửa' : '✏️ Sửa'}</button>
<button type="button" title="Xóa câu này khỏi danh sách nạp" onclick="removeImportQuestion('${kind}', ${qIdx})" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 hover:bg-red-100 text-slate-600 hover:text-red-700 border border-slate-200 text-[11px] font-black transition-colors">🗑</button>
</div>
</div>
<div id="${kind}-prev-stem-${qIdx}" class="math-content text-xs font-extrabold text-slate-900 mb-2 leading-snug">${formatMathAndChemHTML(q.text, { center: true })}</div>
${answerAreaHtml}
${editAreaHtml}`;
listEl.appendChild(card);
});
}

function setImportTF(kind, qIdx, stIdx, val) {
const q = getImportDraft(kind)[qIdx];
if (!q) return;
if (!Array.isArray(q.tfAnswers)) q.tfAnswers = [false, false, false, false];
q.tfAnswers[stIdx] = Boolean(val);
q.detectedByStyle = true;
renderImportPreview(kind);
}

function updateImportAnswer(kind, qIdx, val) {
const q = getImportDraft(kind)[qIdx];
if (!q) return;
q.shortAnswer = String(val == null ? '' : val).trim();
q.detectedByStyle = q.shortAnswer !== '';
const badgeEl = document.getElementById(`${kind}-preview-badge`);
if (badgeEl) {
const d = getImportDraft(kind);
const c = countByType(d);
badgeEl.textContent = `${d.length} câu • I: ${c.mc} • II: ${c.tf} • III: ${c.sa} (${d.filter(x => x.detectedByStyle).length} đã có đáp án)`;
}
}

// Nhập nhanh chuỗi đáp án Phần I: "1A 2B 3C..." hoặc "ABCDABCD..." (chỉ áp dụng cho câu nhiều lựa chọn)
function applyQuickAnswerKey(kind) {
const draft = getImportDraft(kind);
const inputEl = document.getElementById(`${kind}-quick-answer-input`);
if (!inputEl || draft.length === 0) return;
const raw = inputEl.value.trim().toUpperCase();
if (!raw) return;
const mcList = draft.filter(q => qType(q) === 'mc');
if (mcList.length === 0) return;

const numberedMatches = [...raw.matchAll(/(\d{1,3})\s*[\.\:\-\)]?\s*([A-D])/g)];
if (numberedMatches.length > 0) {
numberedMatches.forEach(m => {
const qIdx = parseInt(m[1], 10) - 1;
const optIdx = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'].indexOf(m[2]);
if (mcList[qIdx] && optIdx !== -1) {
mcList[qIdx].correctIndex = optIdx;
mcList[qIdx].detectedByStyle = true;
mcList[qIdx].weakStyle = false;
}
});
} else {
const lettersOnly = raw.replace(/[^A-D]/g, '');
for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(lettersOnly.length, mcList.length); i++) {
const optIdx = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'].indexOf(lettersOnly[i]);
if (optIdx !== -1) {
mcList[i].correctIndex = optIdx;
mcList[i].detectedByStyle = true;
mcList[i].weakStyle = false;
}
}
}
renderImportPreview(kind);
}

function applyImportDraft(kind) {
if (window.CODE93Mix && CODE93Mix.active && kind === 'word') { CODE93Mix.receive(getImportDraft(kind)); return; } // [CODE93] đang ở trang TRỘN ĐỀ THI
const draft = getImportDraft(kind);
const label = kind === 'pdf' ? 'PDF' : 'Word';
if (draft.length === 0) {
showModal('Thông báo', `Chưa có câu hỏi nào từ ${label}! Vui lòng chọn file ${kind === 'pdf' ? 'PDF (.pdf)' : 'Word (.docx) hoặc dán nội dung câu hỏi'} trước.`, 'info');
return;
}

syncEditorDOMToDraft();
const modeRadio = document.querySelector(`input[name="${kind}-import-mode"]:checked`);
const mode = modeRadio ? modeRadio.value : 'replace';

const importedFormatted = draft.map(q => {
const t = qType(q);
const d = makeBlankDraft(t);
d.text = q.text;
d.solution = String(q.solution || '');
d.tfSol = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => String((q.tfSol && q.tfSol[i]) || ''));
if (t === 'tf') {
d.options = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => ({ text: (q.options[i] && q.options[i].text) || '' }));
d.tf = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(i => Boolean(q.tfAnswers && q.tfAnswers[i]));
} else if (t === 'sa') {
d.answer = String(q.shortAnswer || '');
} else {
d.options = q.options.map(o => ({ text: o.text }));
d.correctIndex = q.correctIndex || 0;
}
if (q.gid) d.gid = String(q.gid);
if (q.ginfo) d.ginfo = String(q.ginfo);
if (q.gm) d.gm = String(q.gm); // [CODE121]
if (q.level) d.level = q.level; // [CODE138]
return ensureDraftShape(d);
});
const unresolved = draft.filter(q => !q.detectedByStyle).length;
const emptyOpt = draft.filter(q => qType(q) !== 'sa' && (q.options || []).some(o => !o.text || !o.text.trim() || o.text.trim() === '...')).length;

if (mode === 'append') {
const nonEmptyExisting = editorDraftQuestions.filter(q => (q.text || '').trim() !== '' || (q.answer || '').trim() !== '' || (q.options || []).some(o => (o.text || '').trim() !== ''));
editorDraftQuestions = [...nonEmptyExisting, ...importedFormatted];
} else {
editorDraftQuestions = importedFormatted;
}

syncPaletteAndPatternToCount(editorDraftQuestions.length);
renderEditorForm();
closeWordImportModal();

const c = countByType(editorDraftQuestions);
let msg = `Đã nạp ${importedFormatted.length} câu hỏi từ file ${label} vào bộ đề (Tổng cộng: ${editorDraftQuestions.length} câu: Phần I = ${c.mc}, Phần II = ${c.tf}, Phần III = ${c.sa}).`;
if (unresolved > 0) msg += ` ⚠ ${unresolved} câu chưa xác định đáp án đúng — hãy kiểm tra lại.`;
if (emptyOpt > 0) msg += ` ⚠ ${emptyOpt} câu có phương án trống.`;
showModal((unresolved || emptyOpt) ? 'Đã nạp – cần kiểm tra' : 'Thành công!', msg, (unresolved || emptyOpt) ? 'info' : 'success');
}

function removeEditorQuestion(index) {
if (editorDraftQuestions.length <= 1) {
showModal('Lưu ý', 'Bộ câu hỏi cần có ít nhất 1 câu hỏi!', 'info');
return;
}
syncEditorDOMToDraft();
{ // [CODE33] xóa câu đầu nhóm -> chuyển dữ kiện cho câu kế tiếp trong nhóm
const rm = editorDraftQuestions[index];
if (rm && rm.gid && rm.ginfo) {
const nxt = editorDraftQuestions.find((x, i) => i !== index && x.gid === rm.gid);
if (nxt && !nxt.ginfo) nxt.ginfo = rm.ginfo;
}
}
editorDraftQuestions.splice(index, 1);
if (activePalette.length > editorDraftQuestions.length) {
activePalette.splice(index, 1);
activePalette.forEach((p, idx) => p.slot = idx);
if (!isCustomMatrixEdited && currentPresetKey !== 'blank') {
activeSlotPattern = adaptPresetToPalette(currentPresetKey || 'default', activePalette);
} else {
activeSlotPattern = shiftPatternAfterRemoveSlot(activeSlotPattern, index, activePalette);
}
syncGlobalsFromActiveMatrix();
}
renderEditorForm();
}

const applyStyle = (el, state, stepNum, defaultLabel) => {

el.className = 'flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-300 text-emerald-900 shadow-sm transition-all';
el.innerHTML = `<span class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-emerald-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-[11px]">✓</span><span class="truncate">${defaultLabel}</span>`;
} else if (state === 'active') {
el.className = 'flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-sky-100 border border-sky-400 text-sky-900 shadow-sm animate-pulse transition-all';

} else {

el.innerHTML = `<span class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-[11px]">${stepNum}</span><span class="truncate">${defaultLabel}</span>`;
}
};

applyStyle(s1, step1, 1, 'Bước 1: Đã lưu vào bộ nhớ tạm');
applyStyle(s2, step2, 2, 'Bước 2: Giải mã MathType & Công thức');
applyStyle(s3, step3, 3, 'Bước 3: Kiểm tra trước khi nạp');
if (bufStatus && statusText) {
bufStatus.textContent = statusText;
}
}
