async function processWordFile(file) {
if (!file) return;
if (!/\.docx$/i.test(file.name || '')) {
showModal('Định dạng Word chưa được hỗ trợ', 'Vui lòng mở tệp .doc bằng Microsoft Word và lưu lại thành .docx. Bộ nhập công thức cần định dạng DOCX để đọc OMML/MathType.', 'info');
return;
}
const fileNameEl = document.getElementById('word-file-name');
const listEl = document.getElementById('word-preview-list');

try {
// BƯỚC 1: Tải file Word lên và lưu vào bộ nhớ tạm của App (wordTempMemoryBuffer)
setWordPipelineStepState('active', 'idle', 'idle', `Đang nạp "${file.name}" vào bộ nhớ tạm...`);
if (fileNameEl) {
fileNameEl.textContent = `Bước 1: Đang nạp ${file.name} vào bộ nhớ tạm...`;
fileNameEl.className = 'text-xs font-black text-sky-700 mt-0.5 block';
}
if (listEl) {
listEl.innerHTML = `
<div class="h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center text-sky-700 p-6">
<div class="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-sky-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mb-3"></div>
<p class="text-sm font-black uppercase mb-1">Đang xử lý file Word trong bộ nhớ tạm...</p>
<p class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">Đang giải mã các công thức MathType (mũi tên, phân số, chỉ số) và câu hỏi trắc nghiệm...</p>
</div>
`;
}

const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(arrayBuffer);

// Lưu toàn bộ các thành phần của file Word vào bộ nhớ tạm của App
wordTempMemoryBuffer = {
fileName: file.name,
fileSize: file.size,
loadedAt: Date.now(),
arrayBuffer: arrayBuffer,
zip: zip,
formulaCache: new Map()
};

setWordPipelineStepState('done', 'active', 'idle', `Đã lưu vào bộ nhớ tạm (${(file.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB). Đang giải mã công thức MathType...`);
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 40));

// BƯỚC 2: Đọc và xử lý các câu hỏi, đáp án, công thức MathType / Equation / OMML từ bộ nhớ tạm
decodedMathFormulaCount = 0;
const richLines = await extractRichLinesFromDocxBuffer(wordTempMemoryBuffer);
wordImportDraft = (window.CODE121EN && CODE121EN.active) ? CODE121EN.parse(richLines) : parseExamRichLines(richLines); // [CODE121]
if ((document.getElementById('word-quick-answer-input')?.value || '').trim()) applyQuickAnswerKey('word');

// BƯỚC 3: Sau khi đọc & xử lý xong mới hiển thị lên màn hình để Giáo viên kiểm tra
setWordPipelineStepState(
'done',
'done',
'done',
`Hoàn tất: ${wordImportDraft.length} câu hỏi • Đã giải mã ${decodedMathFormulaCount} công thức MathType/OMML`
);

if (fileNameEl) {
fileNameEl.textContent = `✓ Đã xử lý xong: ${file.name} (${wordImportDraft.length} câu hỏi)`;
fileNameEl.className = 'text-xs font-black text-emerald-600 mt-0.5 block';
}

const mtBadge = document.getElementById('word-mathtype-badge');
if (mtBadge) {
if (decodedMathFormulaCount > 0) {
mtBadge.textContent = `✨ ${decodedMathFormulaCount} công thức MathType/Toán-Hóa`;
mtBadge.classList.remove('hidden');
} else {
mtBadge.classList.add('hidden');
}
}

renderWordImportPreview();
if (wordImportDraft.length === 0) {
showModal('Chưa tìm thấy câu hỏi', 'Không nhận diện được cấu trúc câu hỏi (Phần I: Câu 1... A. B. C. D.; Phần II: a) b) c) d); Phần III: Trả lời: ....).', 'info');
}
} catch (err) {
console.error('Error reading .docx:', err);
setWordPipelineStepState('idle', 'idle', 'idle', 'Lỗi đọc file Word.');
showModal('Lỗi đọc file Word', 'Vui lòng chọn file .docx chuẩn hoặc dùng cách Copy & Dán trực tiếp.', 'info');
}
}

function getXmlAttrVal(el, attrName = 'val') {
if (!el || !el.getAttribute) return '';
// DOCX do not guarantee that relationship attributes always use the
// same namespace prefix. Try the common prefixes, then namespace/localName.
const candidates = [
el.getAttribute(attrName),
el.getAttribute(`w:${attrName}`),
el.getAttribute(`m:${attrName}`),
el.getAttribute(`r:${attrName}`),
el.getAttribute(`o:${attrName}`),
el.getAttribute(`v:${attrName}`)
];
for (const value of candidates) {
if (value !== null && value !== undefined && String(value).trim() !== '') return String(value).trim();
}
if (el.attributes) {
for (let i = 0; i < el.attributes.length; i++) {
const a = el.attributes[i];
if (a && (a.localName === attrName || a.name === attrName || a.name.endsWith(':' + attrName))) {
if (a.value && String(a.value).trim()) return String(a.value).trim();
}
}
}
return '';
}

function checkRunBold(rPr) {
if (!rPr) return false;
for (let i = 0; i < rPr.childNodes.length; i++) {
const n = rPr.childNodes[i];
if (n.localName === 'b' || n.localName === 'bCs') {
const v = getXmlAttrVal(n).toLowerCase();
if (v !== '0' && v !== 'false') return true;
}
}
return false;
}

function checkRunUnderline(rPr) {
if (!rPr) return false;
for (let i = 0; i < rPr.childNodes.length; i++) {
const n = rPr.childNodes[i];
if (n.localName === 'u') {
const v = getXmlAttrVal(n).toLowerCase();
if (v !== 'none' && v !== '0' && v !== 'false') return true;
}
}
return false;
}

function checkRunVertAlign(rPr) {
if (!rPr) return null;
for (let i = 0; i < rPr.childNodes.length; i++) {
const n = rPr.childNodes[i];
if (n.localName === 'vertAlign') {
const v = getXmlAttrVal(n).toLowerCase();
if (v === 'subscript') return 'sub';
if (v === 'superscript') return 'sup';
}
if (n.localName === 'position') {
const posVal = parseInt(getXmlAttrVal(n), 10);
if (!isNaN(posVal)) {
if (posVal < -2) return 'sub';
if (posVal > 2) return 'sup';
}
}
}
return null;
}

function checkRunSymbolFont(rPr) {
if (!rPr) return null;
for (let i = 0; i < rPr.childNodes.length; i++) {
const n = rPr.childNodes[i];
if (n.localName === 'rFonts') {
const ascii = (getXmlAttrVal(n, 'ascii') || getXmlAttrVal(n, 'hAnsi') || getXmlAttrVal(n, 'cs') || '').toLowerCase();
if (ascii.includes('symbol')) return 'symbol';
if (ascii.includes('mt extra')) return 'mtextra';
}
}
return null;
}

const SYMBOL_FONT_CHAR_MAP = {
'F020': ' ', 'F022': '∀', 'F024': '∃', 'F02B': '+', 'F02D': '−', 'F02A': '∗',
'F03C': '<', 'F03D': '=', 'F03E': '>', 'F040': '≅', 'F044': 'Δ', 'F057': 'Ω',
'F05B': '[', 'F05D': ']', 'F05E': '⊥', 'F061': 'α', 'F062': 'β', 'F067': 'γ',
'F064': 'δ', 'F065': 'ε', 'F07A': 'ζ', 'F068': 'η', 'F071': 'θ', 'F06C': 'λ',
'F06D': 'μ', 'F070': 'π', 'F072': 'ρ', 'F073': 'σ', 'F074': 'τ', 'F066': 'φ',
'F076': 'ϖ', 'F077': 'ω', 'F078': 'ξ', 'F079': 'ψ', 'F046': 'Φ', 'F059': 'Ψ',
'F04C': 'Λ', 'F050': 'Π', 'F053': 'Σ', 'F051': 'Θ', 'F0A3': '≤', 'F0A5': '∞',
'F0B0': '°', 'F0B1': '±', 'F0B2': '″', 'F0B3': '≥', 'F0B4': '×', 'F0B5': '∝',
'F0B6': '∂', 'F0B7': '•', 'F0B8': '÷', 'F0B9': '≠', 'F0BA': '≡', 'F0BB': '≈',
'F0C4': '⊗', 'F0C5': '⊕', 'F0C6': '∅', 'F0C7': '∩', 'F0C8': '∪', 'F0CC': '⊂',
'F0CD': '⊆', 'F0CE': '∈', 'F0CF': '∉', 'F0D0': '∠', 'F0D1': '∇', 'F0D6': '√',
'F0D7': '·', 'F0DB': '⇔', 'F0DC': '⇐', 'F0DD': '⇑', 'F0DE': '⇒', 'F0DF': '⇓',
'F0E0': '◊', 'F0E5': '∑', 'F0F2': '∫', 'F0AB': '↔', 'F0AC': '←', 'F0AD': '↑',
'F0AE': '→', 'F0AF': '↓', 'F0BE': '⎯'
};

// Bảng ánh xạ byte (0x20..0xFF) của font Symbol & MT Extra sang ký tự Toán/Hóa học
function decodeSymbolByteToLatexOrChar(byteVal, fontType = 'symbol') {
if (fontType === 'mtextra') {
const mtExtraMap = {
0x21: '\\rightleftharpoons ',
0x22: '\\rightleftharpoons ',
0x23: '\\leftrightarrow ',
0x31: '\\vec{}',
0x43: '\\cdots ',
0x4C: '\\ell ',
0x68: '\\hbar '
};
if (mtExtraMap[byteVal]) return mtExtraMap[byteVal];
}
const hexKey = 'F0' + byteVal.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(2, '0');
if (SYMBOL_FONT_CHAR_MAP[hexKey]) return SYMBOL_FONT_CHAR_MAP[hexKey];
if (byteVal >= 0x20 && byteVal <= 0x7E) return String.fromCharCode(byteVal);
return '';
}

function mapPrivateUseCharsInText(txt, runFontType = null) {
if (!txt) return '';
let out = '';
for (let i = 0; i < txt.length; i++) {
const code = txt.charCodeAt(i);
if (code >= 0xF020 && code <= 0xF0FF) {
const mapped = decodeSymbolByteToLatexOrChar(code & 0xFF, runFontType || 'symbol');
out += mapped || '';
} else if (runFontType === 'symbol' && code >= 0x20 && code <= 0xFF) {
const mapped = decodeSymbolByteToLatexOrChar(code, 'symbol');
out += mapped || txt[i];
} else {
out += txt[i];
}
}
return out;
}

// ============================================================================
// BỘ GIẢI MÃ MATHTYPE (OLE2 Compound File + MTEF v3/v5 + WMF Metafile)
// ============================================================================

function extractEquationNativeFromOLE2(uint8) {
if (!uint8 || uint8.length < 64) return null;

// 1. Đọc cấu trúc chuẩn OLE2 Compound File Binary (D0 CF 11 E0 A1 B1 1A E1)
if (uint8[0] === 0xD0 && uint8[1] === 0xCF && uint8[2] === 0x11 && uint8[3] === 0xE0) {
try {
const view = new DataView(uint8.buffer, uint8.byteOffset, uint8.byteLength);
const sectorShift = view.getUint16(0x1E, true) || 9;
const miniSectorShift = view.getUint16(0x20, true) || 6;
const sectorSize = 1 << sectorShift;
const miniSectorSize = 1 << miniSectorShift;
const numFatSectors = view.getUint32(0x2C, true);
const firstDirSector = view.getUint32(0x30, true);
const miniCutoff = view.getUint32(0x38, true) || 4096;
const firstMiniFatSector = view.getUint32(0x3C, true);
const numMiniFatSectors = view.getUint32(0x40, true);

const difat = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 109 && difat.length < numFatSectors; i++) {
const sec = view.getUint32(0x4C + i * 4, true);
if (sec < 0xFFFFFFFE) difat.push(sec);
}

const fat = [];
for (const fatSec of difat) {
const offset = (fatSec + 1) * sectorSize;
if (offset + sectorSize > uint8.length) break;
for (let j = 0; j < sectorSize; j += 4) {
fat.push(view.getUint32(offset + j, true));
}
}

const readSectorChain = (startSec, maxLen = 0) => {
const chunks = [];
let total = 0;
let cur = startSec;
const visited = new Set();
while (cur < 0xFFFFFFFE && !visited.has(cur)) {
visited.add(cur);
const off = (cur + 1) * sectorSize;
if (off >= uint8.length) break;
const end = Math.min(uint8.length, off + sectorSize);
chunks.push(uint8.subarray(off, end));
total += (end - off);
if (maxLen > 0 && total >= maxLen) break;
cur = fat[cur] !== undefined ? fat[cur] : 0xFFFFFFFE;
}
const res = new Uint8Array(total);
let p = 0;
for (const c of chunks) {
res.set(c, p);
p += c.length;
}
return maxLen > 0 ? res.subarray(0, maxLen) : res;
};

const dirBytes = readSectorChain(firstDirSector);
const dirView = new DataView(dirBytes.buffer, dirBytes.byteOffset, dirBytes.byteLength);

let rootStartSec = 0xFFFFFFFE;
let rootSize = 0;
let eqEntry = null;

for (let off = 0; off + 128 <= dirBytes.length; off += 128) {
const nameLen = dirView.getUint16(off + 64, true);
const objType = dirBytes[off + 66];
if (objType === 0 || nameLen < 2) continue;
let name = '';
for (let k = 0; k < Math.min(62, nameLen - 2); k += 2) {
name += String.fromCharCode(dirView.getUint16(off + k, true));
}
const startSec = dirView.getUint32(off + 116, true);
const streamSize = dirView.getUint32(off + 120, true);

if (objType === 5 || name === 'Root Entry') {
rootStartSec = startSec;
rootSize = streamSize;
} else if (name.toLowerCase().includes('equation native') || name.toLowerCase() === 'matost') {
eqEntry = { startSec, streamSize };
}
}

if (eqEntry && eqEntry.streamSize > 28) {
let streamBytes = null;
if (eqEntry.streamSize < miniCutoff && rootStartSec < 0xFFFFFFFE) {
const miniStreamContainer = readSectorChain(rootStartSec, rootSize);
const miniFatBytes = firstMiniFatSector < 0xFFFFFFFE
? readSectorChain(firstMiniFatSector, numMiniFatSectors * sectorSize)
: new Uint8Array(0);
const miniFatView = new DataView(miniFatBytes.buffer, miniFatBytes.byteOffset, miniFatBytes.byteLength);

const out = new Uint8Array(eqEntry.streamSize);
let curMini = eqEntry.startSec;
let written = 0;
const visitedMini = new Set();
while (curMini < 0xFFFFFFFE && written < eqEntry.streamSize && !visitedMini.has(curMini)) {
visitedMini.add(curMini);
const mOff = curMini * miniSectorSize;
if (mOff >= miniStreamContainer.length) break;
const copyLen = Math.min(miniSectorSize, eqEntry.streamSize - written, miniStreamContainer.length - mOff);
out.set(miniStreamContainer.subarray(mOff, mOff + copyLen), written);
written += copyLen;
if (curMini * 4 + 4 <= miniFatBytes.length) {
curMini = miniFatView.getUint32(curMini * 4, true);
} else {
curMini++;
}
}
streamBytes = out;
} else {
streamBytes = readSectorChain(eqEntry.startSec, eqEntry.streamSize);
}

if (streamBytes && streamBytes.length > 28) {
const sView = new DataView(streamBytes.buffer, streamBytes.byteOffset, streamBytes.byteLength);
const cbHdr = sView.getUint16(0, true);
if (cbHdr >= 28 && cbHdr < streamBytes.length) {
return streamBytes.subarray(cbHdr);
}
}
}
} catch (e) {}
}

// 2. Quét trực tiếp chữ ký EQNOLEFILEHDR (1C 00 00 00 02 00) trong mảng byte
for (let i = 0; i + 34 < uint8.length; i++) {
if (uint8[i] === 0x1C && uint8[i + 1] === 0x00 &&
uint8[i + 2] === 0x00 && uint8[i + 3] === 0x00 &&
uint8[i + 4] === 0x02 && uint8[i + 5] === 0x00) {
const mtefStart = i + 28;
const ver = uint8[mtefStart];
const plat = uint8[mtefStart + 1];
const prod = uint8[mtefStart + 2];
if ((ver >= 2 && ver <= 5) && plat <= 2 && prod <= 2) {
const cbObj = uint8[i + 6] | (uint8[i + 7] << 8) | (uint8[i + 8] << 16) | (uint8[i + 9] << 24);
const endPos = (cbObj > 0 && mtefStart + cbObj <= uint8.length) ? (mtefStart + cbObj) : uint8.length;
return uint8.subarray(mtefStart, endPos);
}
}
}
return null;
}

function extractMtefFromWmfBytes(uint8) {
if (!uint8 || uint8.length < 32) return null;
const chunks = [];
// Tìm các khối comment "AppsMFCC" chứa dữ liệu MTEF trong file WMF
for (let i = 0; i + 24 < uint8.length; i++) {
if (uint8[i] === 0x41 && uint8[i + 1] === 0x70 && uint8[i + 2] === 0x70 && uint8[i + 3] === 0x73 &&
uint8[i + 4] === 0x4D && uint8[i + 5] === 0x46 && uint8[i + 6] === 0x43 && uint8[i + 7] === 0x43) {
const dataLen = uint8[i + 14] | (uint8[i + 15] << 8) | (uint8[i + 16] << 16) | (uint8[i + 17] << 24);
const sigLen = uint8[i + 18] | (uint8[i + 19] << 8);
const payloadStart = i + 20 + sigLen;
if (dataLen > 0 && payloadStart + dataLen <= uint8.length) {
chunks.push(uint8.subarray(payloadStart, payloadStart + dataLen));
i = payloadStart + dataLen - 1;
}
}
}
if (chunks.length > 0) {
const total = chunks.reduce((acc, c) => acc + c.length, 0);
const merged = new Uint8Array(total);
let offset = 0;
for (const c of chunks) {
merged.set(c, offset);
offset += c.length;
}
return merged;
}
return null;
}

function convertMtcodeToLatex(mtcode, fontChar8, typeface, fontDefs) {
// Bảng ánh xạ trực tiếp Unicode / MTCode sang LaTeX chuẩn
const directMap = {
0x2102: '\\mathbb{C} ', 0x2115: '\\mathbb{N} ', 0x211A: '\\mathbb{Q} ', 0x211D: '\\mathbb{R} ', 0x2124: '\\mathbb{Z} ',
0x00B0: '^\\circ ',
0x00B1: '\\pm ',
0x00B7: '\\cdot ',
0x00D7: '\\times ',
0x00F7: '\\div ',
0x0391: 'A', 0x0392: 'B', 0x0393: '\\Gamma ', 0x0394: '\\Delta ',
0x0398: '\\Theta ', 0x039B: '\\Lambda ', 0x039E: '\\Xi ', 0x03A0: '\\Pi ',
0x03A3: '\\Sigma ', 0x03A6: '\\Phi ', 0x03A8: '\\Psi ', 0x03A9: '\\Omega ',
0x03B1: '\\alpha ', 0x03B2: '\\beta ', 0x03B3: '\\gamma ', 0x03B4: '\\delta ',
0x03B5: '\\varepsilon ', 0x03B6: '\\zeta ', 0x03B7: '\\eta ', 0x03B8: '\\theta ',
0x03BA: '\\kappa ', 0x03BB: '\\lambda ', 0x03BC: '\\mu ', 0x03BD: '\\nu ',
0x03BE: '\\xi ', 0x03C0: '\\pi ', 0x03C1: '\\rho ', 0x03C3: '\\sigma ',
0x03C4: '\\tau ', 0x03C6: '\\varphi ', 0x03C7: '\\chi ', 0x03C8: '\\psi ',
0x03C9: '\\omega ', 0x03D1: '\\vartheta ', 0x03D5: '\\phi ',
0x2013: '-', 0x2014: '-', 0x2212: '-',
0x2022: '\\cdot ', 0x2219: '\\cdot ', 0x22C5: '\\cdot ',
0x2026: '\\dots ', 0x22EF: '\\cdots ',
0x2032: "'", 0x2033: "''", 0x2034: "'''",
0x2190: '\\leftarrow ', 0x2191: '\\uparrow ', 0x2192: '\\rightarrow ',
0x2193: '\\downarrow ', 0x2194: '\\leftrightarrow ',
0x2197: '\\nearrow ', 0x2198: '\\searrow ',
0x21BC: '\\leftharpoonup ', 0x21BD: '\\leftharpoondown ',
0x21C0: '\\rightharpoonup ', 0x21C1: '\\rightharpoondown ',
0x21C4: '\\rightleftharpoons ', 0x21C6: '\\rightleftharpoons ',
0x21CB: '\\rightleftharpoons ', 0x21CC: '\\rightleftharpoons ',
0x21D0: '\\Leftarrow ', 0x21D2: '\\Rightarrow ', 0x21D4: '\\Leftrightarrow ',
0x2200: '\\forall ', 0x2202: '\\partial ', 0x2203: '\\exists ',
0x2205: '\\emptyset ', 0x2207: '\\nabla ', 0x2208: '\\in ', 0x2209: '\\notin ',
0x220F: '\\prod ', 0x2211: '\\sum ', 0x221A: '\\sqrt{}', 0x221D: '\\propto ',
0x221E: '\\infty ', 0x2220: '\\angle ', 0x2225: '\\parallel ',
0x2227: '\\wedge ', 0x2228: '\\vee ', 0x2229: '\\cap ', 0x222A: '\\cup ',
0x222B: '\\int ', 0x223C: '\\sim ', 0x2248: '\\approx ', 0x2260: '\\neq ',
0x2261: '\\equiv ', 0x2264: '\\leq ', 0x2265: '\\geq ',
0x2282: '\\subset ', 0x2283: '\\supset ', 0x2286: '\\subseteq ', 0x2287: '\\supseteq ',
0x2295: '\\oplus ', 0x2297: '\\otimes ', 0x22A5: '\\perp ',
0x25B3: '\\triangle ', 0x25CA: '\\lozenge ', 0x27F5: '\\leftarrow ',
0x27F6: '\\rightarrow ', 0x27F7: '\\leftrightarrow ',
0x27F8: '\\Leftarrow ', 0x27F9: '\\Rightarrow ', 0x27FA: '\\Leftrightarrow '
};

if (directMap[mtcode] !== undefined) return directMap[mtcode];

// Vùng Private Use Area của MathType (0xE000..0xF0FF)
if (mtcode >= 0xF020 && mtcode <= 0xF0FF) {
const low = mtcode & 0xFF;
let fType = 'symbol';
if (typeface === 11) fType = 'mtextra';
else if (typeface < 0 && fontDefs[-typeface]) {
const fName = fontDefs[-typeface].toLowerCase();
if (fName.includes('extra')) fType = 'mtextra';
}
const symChar = decodeSymbolByteToLatexOrChar(low, fType);
if (symChar) {
const uCode = symChar.charCodeAt(0);
return directMap[uCode] || symChar;
}
}

if (mtcode >= 0xE900 && mtcode <= 0xEBFF) {
// Vùng ký tự mở rộng MTCode cho mũi tên thuận nghịch & harpoon
if (mtcode === 0xEB01 || mtcode === 0xEB02 || mtcode === 0xE932 || mtcode === 0xE933 || fontChar8 === 0x21 || fontChar8 === 0x22) {
return '\\rightleftharpoons ';
}
if (mtcode === 0xE98F || mtcode === 0xE990) return '\\rightarrow ';
}

// Nếu là MTEF v3 hoặc chỉ có mã 8-bit thuộc font Symbol / MT Extra
if (mtcode >= 0x20 && mtcode <= 0xFF && (typeface === 4 || typeface === 5 || typeface === 6 || typeface === 11)) {
const symChar = decodeSymbolByteToLatexOrChar(mtcode & 0xFF, typeface === 11 ? 'mtextra' : 'symbol');
if (symChar) {
const uCode = symChar.charCodeAt(0);
return directMap[uCode] || symChar;
}
}

if (mtcode >= 0x20 && mtcode <= 0x7E) {
const ch = String.fromCharCode(mtcode);
if (ch === '{') return '\\{';
if (ch === '}') return '\\}';
if (ch === '%') return '\\%';
if (ch === '\\') return '\\setminus '; // [CODE32] ℝ \ {1}
if (ch === '#' || ch === '$' || ch === '&' || ch === '_') return '\\' + ch;
if (ch === '^') return '\\^{}';
if (ch === '~') return '\\sim ';
return ch;
}

if (mtcode > 0x7E && mtcode < 0xE000) {
return String.fromCharCode(mtcode);
}
return '';
}

// [CODE32] Xếp dòng bằng array (căn trái/giữa/phải theo MathType) - "aligned" không có & sẽ căn PHẢI nên hệ phương trình bị lệch.
function _mtefArr(rows, ha) {
const a = ha === 3 ? 'r' : (ha === 2 ? 'c' : 'l');
const hasFrac = rows.some(r => /\\d?frac/.test(r));
const body = rows.map(r => String(r).replace(/\\frac/g, '\\dfrac').replace(/(?:\\ |\s)+$/, '')).join(hasFrac ? ' \\\\[0.7em] ' : ' \\\\ ');
return `\\begin{array}{${a}} ${body} \\end{array}`;
}

function parseMtefBytesToLatex(bytes) {
if (!bytes || bytes.length < 6) return '';
const mtefVer = bytes[0];
if (mtefVer < 2 || mtefVer > 5) return '';

let pos = 5;
if (mtefVer >= 5) {
while (pos < bytes.length && bytes[pos] !== 0) pos++;
pos++; // Bỏ qua null byte của application key
if (pos < bytes.length) pos++; // Bỏ qua byte equation options
} else if (mtefVer === 4) {
if (pos < bytes.length) pos++;
}

const fontDefs = {};
let fontDefCounter = 1;
// Keep nested MathType template fragments as a recovery path. Some legacy
// Equation.DSMT4 objects have incomplete slot terminators; the top-level
// parse can otherwise return only a base symbol (e.g. K_C or Delta_r).
const templateFragments = [];

const readUInt8 = () => (pos < bytes.length ? bytes[pos++] : 0);
const readUInt16 = () => {
if (pos + 1 >= bytes.length) { pos = bytes.length; return 0; }
const v = bytes[pos] | (bytes[pos + 1] << 8);
pos += 2;
return v;
};
const readMtefUInt = () => {
const b1 = readUInt8();
if (b1 < 0x80) return b1;
const b2 = readUInt8();
return ((b1 & 0x7F) << 8) | b2;
};
const readMtefSInt = () => {
const b1 = readUInt8();
if (mtefVer >= 5 && b1 === 255) {
const u16 = readUInt16();
return u16 - 32768;
}
return b1 - 128;
};
const readNullString = () => {
let s = '';
while (pos < bytes.length) {
const b = bytes[pos++];
if (b === 0) break;
s += String.fromCharCode(b);
}
return s;
};
const skipNudge = () => {
const b1 = readUInt8();
const b2 = readUInt8();
if (b1 === 128 && b2 === 128) pos += 4;
};
const skipNibbleDims = () => {
const count = readUInt8();
let nibIdx = 0;
let curByte = 0;
const nextNib = () => {
if (nibIdx % 2 === 0) {
curByte = readUInt8();
nibIdx++;
return (curByte >> 4) & 0x0F;
} else {
nibIdx++;
return curByte & 0x0F;
}
};
for (let i = 0; i < count && pos < bytes.length; i++) {
nextNib(); // units nibble
let safety = 0;
while (pos <= bytes.length && safety++ < 32) {
if (nextNib() === 0x0F) break;
}
}
};
const skipRuler = () => {
const nStops = readUInt8();
for (let i = 0; i < nStops && pos < bytes.length; i++) {
readUInt8();
readUInt16();
}
};

function parseEmbellList(baseStr) {
let res = baseStr;
while (pos < bytes.length) {
const rawRec = readUInt8();
const recType = mtefVer <= 3 ? (rawRec & 0x0F) : rawRec;
if (recType === 0) break;
if (recType === 6) {
const opt = mtefVer <= 3 ? (rawRec >> 4) : readUInt8();
if (opt & 0x08) skipNudge();
const embType = readUInt8();
if (embType === 2) res = `\\dot{${res}}`;
else if (embType === 3) res = `\\ddot{${res}}`;
else if (embType === 5) res = `${res}'`;
else if (embType === 6) res = `${res}''`;
else if (embType === 8) res = `\\tilde{${res}}`;
else if (embType === 9) res = `\\hat{${res}}`;
else if (embType === 11 || embType === 12 || embType === 13) res = `\\vec{${res}}`;
else if (embType === 17) res = `\\bar{${res}}`;
} else {
// Skip unexpected record inside embell list
break;
}
}
return res;
}

function parseObjectList(inTemplate = false) {
const tokens = [];
const slots = [];
const tmplChars = [];
const piles = []; // [CODE10] các PILE (xếp dòng) nằm trực tiếp trong template, VD: hàm số chia khoảng

while (pos < bytes.length) {
const rawRec = readUInt8();
const recType = mtefVer <= 3 ? (rawRec & 0x0F) : rawRec;
const v3Opt = mtefVer <= 3 ? (rawRec >> 4) : 0;

if (recType === 0) {
break; // END record
}

if (recType >= 100) {
const skipLen = readMtefUInt();
pos += skipLen;
continue;
}

switch (recType) {
case 1: { // LINE
// [CODE9] Cờ theo đúng đặc tả MTEF: 0x01 = dòng rỗng, 0x02 = có RULER, 0x04 = có line-spacing, 0x08 = nudge
const opt = mtefVer <= 3 ? v3Opt : readUInt8();
if (opt & 0x08) skipNudge();
if (opt & 0x04) readUInt16(); // line spacing
if (opt & 0x02) {
if (bytes[pos] === 7) { pos++; skipRuler(); }
}
if (opt & 0x01) {
// mtefOPT_LINE_NULL: slot rỗng, KHÔNG có danh sách đối tượng và KHÔNG có END
slots.push('');
} else {
const childRes = parseObjectList(false);
slots.push(childRes.latex);
if (childRes.latex) tokens.push(childRes.latex);
}
break;
}
case 2: { // CHAR
// [CODE9] Cờ CHAR theo đặc tả: 0x01 = có embellishment, 0x04 = có mã 8-bit, 0x08 = nudge, 0x10 = có mã 16-bit, 0x20 = không có mtcode
const opt = mtefVer <= 3 ? v3Opt : readUInt8();
if (opt & 0x08) skipNudge();
const typeface = readMtefSInt();
let mtcode = 0;
let fontChar8 = 0;
if (mtefVer <= 3) {
const code16 = readUInt16();
mtcode = code16;
fontChar8 = code16 & 0xFF;
} else {
if (!(opt & 0x20)) mtcode = readUInt16();
if (opt & 0x04) fontChar8 = readUInt8();
if (opt & 0x10) {
const fc16 = readUInt16();
if (!mtcode) mtcode = fc16;
}
}
let chLatex = convertMtcodeToLatex(mtcode, fontChar8, typeface, fontDefs);
if (opt & 0x01) {
chLatex = parseEmbellList(chLatex || ' ');
}
if (inTemplate) {
tmplChars.push({ mtcode, fontChar8, latex: chLatex });
}
if (chLatex) tokens.push(chLatex);
break;
}
case 3: { // TMPL (Template: Phân số, Chỉ số trên/dưới, Mũi tên, Căn thức, Ngoặc...)
const opt = mtefVer <= 3 ? v3Opt : readUInt8();
if (opt & 0x08) skipNudge();
const selector = readUInt8();
let variation = readUInt8();
if (mtefVer >= 5 && (variation & 0x80)) {
const v2 = readUInt8();
variation = (variation & 0x7F) | (v2 << 7);
}
const tmplSpecOpt = readUInt8();

const child = parseObjectList(true);
const s = child.slots;
const nonEmptySlots = s.filter(x => x && x.trim() !== '');
let tmplLatex = '';

// [CODE32] Hệ / hệ hợp có nhiều dòng trong ngoặc: vẽ ngoặc cao đúng phía (chỉ trái, chỉ phải hoặc cả hai)
const _fenceDef = { 0: ['\\langle', '\\rangle'], 1: ['(', ')'], 2: ['\\{', '\\}'], 3: ['[', ']'], 4: ['|', '|'], 5: ['\\|', '\\|'] };
const _pile0 = (child.piles && child.piles.length) ? child.piles[0] : null;
if (_fenceDef[selector] && _pile0 && _pile0.length > 1) {
const both = (variation & 0x03) === 0;
const L = (both || (variation & 0x01)) ? _fenceDef[selector][0] : '.';
const R = (both || (variation & 0x02)) ? _fenceDef[selector][1] : '.';
tmplLatex = `\\left${L} ${_mtefArr(_pile0, _pile0.align)} \\right${R}`;
} else if (selector === 0) { // Angle brackets
tmplLatex = `\\langle ${s[0] || ''} \\rangle`;
} else if (selector === 1) { // Parentheses ( )
tmplLatex = /\\(?:d?frac|sqrt|sum|int)/.test(s[0] || '') ? `\\left(${(s[0] || '').replace(/\\frac/g, '\\dfrac')}\\right)` : `(${s[0] || ''})`;
} else if (selector === 2) { // Braces { } or cases
const inner = s[0] || '';
const pileRows = (child.piles && child.piles.length) ? child.piles[0] : null;
const fenceL = !!(variation & 0x01);
const fenceR = !!(variation & 0x02);
if (pileRows && pileRows.length > 1 && fenceL && !fenceR) {
// [CODE10] Hệ / hàm số chia khoảng: { ... (nhiều dòng)
const rowsTex = pileRows.map(r => r.replace(/\\frac/g, '\\dfrac')
.replace(/khi/g, '\\ \\text{khi}\\ ')
.replace(/nếu/g, '\\ \\text{nếu}\\ '));
tmplLatex = `\\begin{cases} ${rowsTex.join(' \\\\ ')} \\end{cases}`;
} else if (pileRows && pileRows.length > 1 && fenceR && !fenceL) {
tmplLatex = `\\left. \\begin{aligned} ${pileRows.join(' \\\\ ')} \\end{aligned} \\right\\}`;
} else if (pileRows && pileRows.length > 1) {
tmplLatex = `\\left\\{ \\begin{aligned} ${pileRows.join(' \\\\ ')} \\end{aligned} \\right\\}`;
} else if ((variation === 1 || (variation & 0x03) === 1) && inner.includes('\\\\')) {
tmplLatex = `\\begin{cases} ${inner} \\end{cases}`;
} else {
tmplLatex = `\\{${inner}\\}`;
}
} else if (selector === 3) { // Square brackets [ ]
tmplLatex = /\\(?:d?frac|sqrt|sum|int)/.test(s[0] || '') ? `\\left[${s[0] || ''}\\right]` : `[${s[0] || ''}]`;
} else if (selector === 4) { // Vertical bar | |
tmplLatex = `|${s[0] || ''}|`;
} else if (selector === 5) { // Double bar || ||
tmplLatex = `\\|${s[0] || ''}\\|`;
} else if (selector === 10) { // Root / Radical
const mainSlot = s[0] || '';
const degSlot = s[1] || '';
tmplLatex = degSlot ? `\\sqrt[${degSlot}]{${mainSlot}}` : `\\sqrt{${mainSlot}}`;
} else if (selector === 11) { // Fraction
const num = s[0] !== undefined ? s[0] : (nonEmptySlots[0] || '');
const den = s[1] !== undefined ? s[1] : (nonEmptySlots[1] || '');
tmplLatex = `\\frac{${num}}{${den}}`;
} else if (selector === 12) { // Underbar
tmplLatex = `\\underline{${s[0] || ''}}`;
} else if (selector === 13) { // Overbar
tmplLatex = `\\overline{${s[0] || ''}}`;
} else if (selector === 14) { // Arrow template (Mũi tên / Mũi tên thuận nghịch có điều kiện)
let arrowCmd = '\\rightarrow ';
const hasReversibleChar = child.tmplChars.some(tc =>
tc.latex.includes('rightleftharpoons') ||
tc.latex.includes('leftrightarrow') ||
tc.latex.includes('harpoon') ||
tc.mtcode === 0x21CC || tc.mtcode === 0x21CB || tc.mtcode === 0x21C4 ||
tc.mtcode === 0x21C0 || tc.mtcode === 0x21BD
);
const arrowCharCount = child.tmplChars.filter(tc =>
tc.latex.includes('arrow') || tc.latex.includes('harpoon')
).length;

if (hasReversibleChar || arrowCharCount >= 2 || (variation & 0x0002) || (variation & 0x0001) || ((variation & 0x0030) === 0x0030)) {
arrowCmd = '\\rightleftharpoons ';
} else if ((variation & 0x0010) && !(variation & 0x0020)) {
arrowCmd = '\\leftarrow ';
}

let topTxt = '';
let botTxt = '';
if ((variation & 0x0004) && !(variation & 0x0008)) {
topTxt = nonEmptySlots[0] || '';
} else if ((variation & 0x0008) && !(variation & 0x0004)) {
botTxt = nonEmptySlots[0] || '';
} else {
topTxt = s[0] || '';

try {

.replace(/\s*([=+\-])\s*/g, '$1')

const candidates = fractionParts.filter(x => {

function parseWmfRecordsFallbackToLatex(uint8) {
if (!uint8 || uint8.length < 24) return '';

// Kiểm tra Aldus Placeable Metafile Header (0x9AC6CDD7)
if (view.getUint32(0, true) === 0x9AC6CDD7) {
offset = 22;
}
if (offset + 18 > uint8.length) return '';
const mtType = view.getUint16(offset, true);
const mtHeaderSize = view.getUint16(offset + 2, true);
if ((mtType !== 1 && mtType !== 2) || mtHeaderSize < 9) return '';

offset += mtHeaderSize * 2;
const gdiObjects = [];
let activeFont = { face: 'times', height: 12 };
const textItems = [];
const horizLines = [];
let curX = 0, curY = 0;

while (offset + 6 <= uint8.length) {
const rdSizeWords = view.getUint32(offset, true);
const rdFunc = view.getUint16(offset + 4, true);
if (rdFunc === 0 || rdSizeWords < 3) break;
const recByteLen = rdSizeWords * 2;
if (offset + recByteLen > uint8.length) break;

if (rdFunc === 0x02FB && recByteLen >= 24) { // META_CREATEFONTINDIRECT
const lfHeight = Math.abs(view.getInt16(offset + 6, true)) || 12;
let face = '';
for (let p = offset + 24; p < offset + recByteLen; p++) {
if (uint8[p] === 0) break;
face += String.fromCharCode(uint8[p]);
}
gdiObjects.push({ type: 'font', face: face.toLowerCase(), height: lfHeight });
} else if (rdFunc === 0x0102 || rdFunc === 0x02FA || rdFunc === 0x02FC) {
gdiObjects.push({ type: 'other' });
} else if (rdFunc === 0x012D && recByteLen >= 8) { // META_SELECTOBJECT

activeFont = gdiObjects[idx];

const idx = view.getUint16(offset + 6, true);
if (gdiObjects[idx]) gdiObjects[idx] = null;

curY = view.getInt16(offset + 6, true);
curX = view.getInt16(offset + 8, true);

const nx = view.getInt16(offset + 8, true);

horizLines.push({ xMin: Math.min(curX, nx), xMax: Math.max(curX, nx), y: (curY + ny) / 2 });

curX = nx; curY = ny;

function resolveDocxTargetPath(rawTarget) {
if (!rawTarget) return '';
let clean = String(rawTarget).trim().replace(/\\/g, '/');
if (!clean) return '';
// Relationship targets are relative to word/document.xml unless absolute.
if (clean.startsWith('/')) clean = clean.slice(1);
else if (!clean.startsWith('word/')) clean = 'word/' + clean;
const parts = [];
for (const part of clean.split('/')) {
if (!part || part === '.') continue;
if (part === '..') parts.pop();
else parts.push(part);
}
return parts.join('/');
}

// ===================== [CODE95] BỘ VẼ FILE EMF -> PNG (hình vẽ cấu tạo hóa học dán từ Word) =====================
// Trình duyệt không hiển thị được ảnh .emf nên đề gốc có hình EMF (vd: công thức cấu tạo ở câu 18) bị mất.

else if (n === 1) brush = { color: '#c0c0c0', none: false };
else if (n === 2) brush = { color: '#808080', none: false };
else if (n === 3) brush = { color: '#404040', none: false };
else if (n === 4) brush = { color: '#000', none: false };
else if (n === 5) brush = { color: '#fff', none: true };

const readPts32 = (o, n) => { const a = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) a.push([dv.getInt32(o + i * 8, true), dv.getInt32(o + i * 8 + 4, true)]); return a; };
const wstr = (o, n) => { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) s += String.fromCharCode(dv.getUint16(o + i * 2, true)); return s; };

let pos = 0, guard = 0;
while (pos + 8 <= u8.length && guard++ < 200000) {
const type = dv.getUint32(pos, true), size = dv.getUint32(pos + 4, true);
if (size < 8 || pos + size > u8.length) break;
const o = pos;
switch (type) {
case 14: pos = u8.length; break; // EOF
case 9: win.ex = dv.getInt32(o + 8, true) || 1; win.ey = dv.getInt32(o + 12, true) || 1; break; // SETWINDOWEXTEX
case 10: win.ox = dv.getInt32(o + 8, true); win.oy = dv.getInt32(o + 12, true); break; // SETWINDOWORGEX
case 11: vp.ex = dv.getInt32(o + 8, true) || 1; vp.ey = dv.getInt32(o + 12, true) || 1; break; // SETVIEWPORTEXTEX
case 12: vp.ox = dv.getInt32(o + 8, true); vp.oy = dv.getInt32(o + 12, true); break; // SETVIEWPORTORGEX
case 17: mapMode = dv.getUint32(o + 8, true); if (mapMode === 1) { win = { ox: win.ox, oy: win.oy, ex: 1, ey: 1 }; vp = { ox: vp.ox, oy: vp.oy, ex: 1, ey: 1 }; } break; // SETMAPMODE
case 18: bkMode = dv.getUint32(o + 8, true); break;

case 22: txtAlign = dv.getUint32(o + 8, true); break;
case 24: txtColor = col(dv.getUint32(o + 8, true)); break;
case 27: cur = { x: dv.getInt32(o + 8, true), y: dv.getInt32(o + 12, true) }; if (inPath) { const q = T(cur.x, cur.y); ctx.moveTo(q[0], q[1]); } break; // MOVETOEX
case 54: { // LINETO
const nx = dv.getInt32(o + 8, true), ny = dv.getInt32(o + 12, true);

const a = T(cur.x, cur.y), b = T(nx, ny);

}
case 33: stack.push({ xf: xf.slice(), win: Object.assign({}, win), vp: Object.assign({}, vp), mapMode, pen: Object.assign({}, pen), brush: Object.assign({}, brush), font: Object.assign({}, font), txtColor, txtAlign, bkMode }); break; // SAVEDC
case 34: { // RESTOREDC
const rel = dv.getInt32(o + 8, true); let n = rel < 0 ? -rel : 1; let st = null;
while (n-- > 0 && stack.length) st = stack.pop();
if (st) { xf = st.xf; win = st.win; vp = st.vp; mapMode = st.mapMode; pen = st.pen; brush = st.brush; font = st.font; txtColor = st.txtColor; txtAlign = st.txtAlign; bkMode = st.bkMode; }
break;
}
case 35: xf = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => dv.getFloat32(o + 8 + i * 4, true)); break; // SETWORLDTRANSFORM
case 36: { // MODIFYWORLDTRANSFORM
const m = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => dv.getFloat32(o + 8 + i * 4, true)); const mode = dv.getUint32(o + 32, true);
if (mode === 1) xf = [1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]; else if (mode === 2) xf = mul(m, xf); else if (mode === 3) xf = mul(xf, m); else if (mode === 4) xf = m;
break;
}
case 37: { // SELECTOBJECT
const id = dv.getUint32(o + 8, true);
if (id & 0x80000000) stock(id & 0x7fffffff); else if (objs[id]) { const ob = objs[id]; if (ob.k === 'pen') pen = ob.v; else if (ob.k === 'brush') brush = ob.v; else if (ob.k === 'font') font = ob.v; }
break;
}
case 38: { const id = dv.getUint32(o + 8, true), st = dv.getUint32(o + 12, true); objs[id] = { k: 'pen', v: { w: dv.getInt32(o + 16, true), color: col(dv.getUint32(o + 24, true)), none: st === 5 } }; break; } // CREATEPEN
case 95: { const id = dv.getUint32(o + 8, true), st = dv.getUint32(o + 28, true) & 0xff; objs[id] = { k: 'pen', v: { w: dv.getUint32(o + 32, true), color: col(dv.getUint32(o + 40, true)), none: st === 5 } }; break; } // EXTCREATEPEN
case 39: { const id = dv.getUint32(o + 8, true), st = dv.getUint32(o + 12, true); objs[id] = { k: 'brush', v: { color: col(dv.getUint32(o + 16, true)), none: st === 1 } }; break; } // CREATEBRUSHINDIRECT
case 82: { // EXTCREATEFONTINDIRECTW
const id = dv.getUint32(o + 8, true);
let face = ''; for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) { const c = dv.getUint16(o + 40 + i * 2, true); if (!c) break; face += String.fromCharCode(c); }
objs[id] = { k: 'font', v: { h: Math.abs(dv.getInt32(o + 12, true)) || 12, face: face || 'Arial', bold: dv.getInt32(o + 28, true) >= 600, italic: dv.getUint8(o + 32) !== 0 } };
break;
}
case 40: delete objs[dv.getUint32(o + 8, true)]; break; // DELETEOBJECT
case 59: path = true; inPath = true; ctx.beginPath(); break; // BEGINPATH
case 60: inPath = false; break; // ENDPATH
case 61: if (inPath) ctx.closePath(); break; // CLOSEFIGURE
case 62: fillNow(); break; // FILLPATH
case 63: fillNow(); strokeNow(); break; // STROKEANDFILLPATH
case 64: strokeNow(); break; // STROKEPATH
case 3: case 4: case 5: case 6: case 7: { // POLYGON / POLYLINE / POLYBEZIERTO / POLYLINETO (32 bit)
const n = dv.getUint32(o + 24, true), pts = readPts32(o + 28, n);
if (type === 3) poly(pts, true, true, true); else if (type === 4) poly(pts, false, false, true);
else { poly([[cur.x, cur.y]].concat(pts), false, false, true); if (pts.length) cur = { x: pts[pts.length - 1][0], y: pts[pts.length - 1][1] }; }
break;

case 86: case 87: case 89: case 90: { // POLYGON16 / POLYLINE16 / POLYLINETO16 / POLYBEZIERTO16
const n = dv.getUint32(o + 24, true), pts = readPts16(o + 28, n);
if (type === 86) poly(pts, true, true, true); else if (type === 87) poly(pts, false, false, true);
else { poly([[cur.x, cur.y]].concat(pts), false, false, true); if (pts.length) cur = { x: pts[pts.length - 1][0], y: pts[pts.length - 1][1] }; }
break;

case 85: { // POLYBEZIER16
const n = dv.getUint32(o + 24, true), p = readPts16(o + 28, n);
if (!inPath) ctx.beginPath();

for (let i = 1; i + 2 < n + 0; i += 3) { const a = T(p[i][0], p[i][1]), b = T(p[i + 1][0], p[i + 1][1]), c = T(p[i + 2][0], p[i + 2][1]); ctx.bezierCurveTo(a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1], c[0], c[1]); }
if (!inPath) strokeNow();
break;
}
case 2: { // POLYBEZIER (32 bit)
const n = dv.getUint32(o + 24, true), p = readPts32(o + 28, n);
if (!inPath) ctx.beginPath();
let q = T(p[0][0], p[0][1]); ctx.moveTo(q[0], q[1]);
for (let i = 1; i + 2 < n + 0; i += 3) { const a = T(p[i][0], p[i][1]), b = T(p[i + 1][0], p[i + 1][1]), c = T(p[i + 2][0], p[i + 2][1]); ctx.bezierCurveTo(a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1], c[0], c[1]); }
if (!inPath) strokeNow();
break;
}
case 43: case 42: { // RECTANGLE / ELLIPSE
const l = dv.getInt32(o + 8, true), t = dv.getInt32(o + 12, true), r = dv.getInt32(o + 16, true), b = dv.getInt32(o + 20, true);
if (!inPath) ctx.beginPath();
if (type === 43) { const a = T(l, t), c = T(r, t), d = T(r, b), e = T(l, b); ctx.moveTo(a[0], a[1]); ctx.lineTo(c[0], c[1]); ctx.lineTo(d[0], d[1]); ctx.lineTo(e[0], e[1]); ctx.closePath(); }
else { const a = T((l + r) / 2, (t + b) / 2), s = unit(); ctx.ellipse(a[0], a[1], Math.abs(r - l) / 2 * s, Math.abs(b - t) / 2 * s, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); }

case 76: { // BITBLT (chỉ xử lý tô nền PATCOPY / WHITENESS / BLACKNESS)
const x = dv.getInt32(o + 24, true), y = dv.getInt32(o + 28, true), w = dv.getInt32(o + 32, true), h = dv.getInt32(o + 36, true), rop = dv.getUint32(o + 40, true);
if (rop === 0x00FF0062 || rop === 0x00000042 || rop === 0x00F00021) {

}
break;

case 84: { // EXTTEXTOUTW

if (n > 0 && n < 4096 && o + off + n * 2 <= u8.length) {
const s = wstr(o + off, n), p = T(rx, ry), fh = Math.max(4, font.h * unit());

ctx.textAlign = h === 6 ? 'center' : h === 2 ? 'right' : 'left';
ctx.textBaseline = v === 24 ? 'alphabetic' : v === 8 ? 'bottom' : 'top';

}
if (pos < u8.length) pos += size;
}
return { dataUrl: cv.toDataURL('image/png'), w: bw, h: bh };
} catch (e) {
console.warn('[CODE95] emfToPngInfo', e);
return null;
}
}

async function decodeDocxFormulaObject(node, relsMap, bufferObj) {
if (!node || !bufferObj || !bufferObj.zip) return '';
const zip = bufferObj.zip;
const cache = bufferObj.formulaCache;

const oleIds = [];
const imgIds = [];

const pushUnique = (list, value) => {
const id = String(value || '').trim();
if (id && !list.includes(id)) list.push(id);
};
let origW = 0, origH = 0, hasBlip = false;
// [CODE161] căn lề ảnh: ảnh nổi (wp:anchor) theo positionH; ảnh trong đoạn chỉ có hình theo căn lề của đoạn
const alSuffix = () => {
let a = '';
try {
// [CODE168] ảnh nổi có chữ bao quanh: L = ảnh nằm bên trái, chữ chạy bên phải; R = ngược lại
const all0 = node.getElementsByTagName('*');
let anc = null, wrapSq = false, cxE = 0;
for (let i = 0; i < all0.length; i++) {
const ln0 = all0[i].localName;
if (ln0 === 'anchor') anc = all0[i];
else if (ln0 === 'wrapSquare' || ln0 === 'wrapTight' || ln0 === 'wrapThrough') wrapSq = true;
else if (ln0 === 'extent' && !cxE) cxE = parseInt(all0[i].getAttribute('cx'), 10) || 0;
}
if (anc && wrapSq && anc.getAttribute('behindDoc') !== '1') {
for (let i = 0; i < all0.length && !a; i++) {
if (all0[i].localName !== 'positionH') continue;
const al0 = findDirectChildByLocalName(all0[i], 'align');
const po0 = findDirectChildByLocalName(all0[i], 'posOffset');
const v0 = al0 ? String(al0.textContent || '').trim() : '';
if (v0 === 'left' || v0 === 'inside') a = 'L';
else if (v0 === 'right' || v0 === 'outside') a = 'R';
else if (!v0 && po0) {
const off = parseInt(po0.textContent, 10) || 0;
const rel = all0[i].getAttribute('relativeFrom') || 'column';
const TEXTW = 6120000, PAGEL = 720000; // vùng chữ A4 (lề 2 cm) tính bằng EMU
const x0 = rel === 'page' ? off - PAGEL : off;
a = (x0 + cxE / 2) < TEXTW / 2 ? 'L' : 'R';
}
}
if (a) return '#al=' + a;
}
const all = node.getElementsByTagName('*');
for (let i = 0; i < all.length && !a; i++) {
if (all[i].localName !== 'positionH') continue;
const al = findDirectChildByLocalName(all[i], 'align');
const v = al ? String(al.textContent || '').trim() : '';
a = v === 'center' ? 'c' : v === 'right' ? 'r' : v === 'left' ? 'l' : '';
}
} catch (e) {}
if (!a) a = window.__mxParaAl || '';
return a ? '#al=' + a : '';
};
const scanRIds = (el) => {
if (!el) return;
const local = el.localName || (el.nodeName || '').split(':').pop();
if (local === 'extent' && !origW) {
// wp:extent: cx, cy tính bằng EMU (9525 EMU = 1px)
const cx = parseInt(el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('cx'), 10);
const cy = parseInt(el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('cy'), 10);
if (cx > 0 && cy > 0) { origW = Math.round(cx / 9525); origH = Math.round(cy / 9525); }
} else if (local === 'shape' && !origW && el.getAttribute) {
// v:shape style="width:..pt;height:..pt" (1pt = 96/72 px)
const st = el.getAttribute('style') || '';
const mw = st.match(/width:\s*([\d.]+)(pt|px)/i);
const mh = st.match(/height:\s*([\d.]+)(pt|px)/i);
if (mw && mh) {
const k = (u) => (u.toLowerCase() === 'pt' ? 96 / 72 : 1);
origW = Math.round(parseFloat(mw[1]) * k(mw[2]));
origH = Math.round(parseFloat(mh[1]) * k(mh[2]));
}
}
if (local === 'OLEObject') {
pushUnique(oleIds, getXmlAttrVal(el, 'id'));
} else if (local === 'imagedata') {
pushUnique(imgIds, getXmlAttrVal(el, 'id'));
} else if (local === 'blip') {
hasBlip = true;
pushUnique(imgIds, getXmlAttrVal(el, 'embed') || getXmlAttrVal(el, 'id'));
}
if (el.childNodes) {
for (let i = 0; i < el.childNodes.length; i++) {
scanRIds(el.childNodes[i]);
}
}
};
scanRIds(node);

const cacheKey = [...oleIds, ...imgIds].join('|') + (origW ? `#${origW}x${origH}` : '');
if (cacheKey && cache.has(cacheKey)) {
const cached = cache.get(cacheKey);
if (cached) decodedMathFormulaCount++;
return cached;
}

let latexResult = '';

// 1. Ưu tiên giải mã từ OLE Object (word/embeddings/oleObjectX.bin)
for (const rId of oleIds) {
const targetPath = relsMap[rId];
if (!targetPath) continue;
const fileEntry = zip.file(targetPath);
if (!fileEntry) continue;
const uint8 = await fileEntry.async('uint8array');
const mtefBytes = extractEquationNativeFromOLE2(uint8);
if (mtefBytes) {
latexResult = parseMtefBytesToLatex(mtefBytes);
if (latexResult) break;
}
// Some MathType versions wrap the equation stream differently.
// Scan additional EQNOLEFILEHDR signatures rather than giving up
// after the first candidate returned by the basic OLE reader.
for (let p = 0; !latexResult && p + 34 < uint8.length; p++) {
if (uint8[p] !== 0x1C || uint8[p + 1] !== 0x00 ||
uint8[p + 2] !== 0x00 || uint8[p + 3] !== 0x00 ||
uint8[p + 4] !== 0x02 || uint8[p + 5] !== 0x00) continue;
const start = p + 28;
const version = uint8[start];
if (version < 2 || version > 5 || start >= uint8.length) continue;
const size = (uint8[p + 6] | (uint8[p + 7] << 8) |
(uint8[p + 8] << 16) | (uint8[p + 9] << 24)) >>> 0;
const end = size > 0 && start + size <= uint8.length ? start + size : uint8.length;
const candidate = parseMtefBytesToLatex(uint8.subarray(start, end));
if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) latexResult = candidate;
}
}

// 2. Nếu chưa có, giải mã từ file WMF/EMF preview (word/media/imageX.wmf)
if (!latexResult) {
for (const rId of imgIds) {
const targetPath = relsMap[rId];
if (!targetPath) continue;
const fileEntry = zip.file(targetPath);
if (!fileEntry) continue;
const lowerPath = targetPath.toLowerCase();

// [CODE95] Hình vẽ (không phải công thức OLE) dạng EMF: vẽ lại thành ảnh PNG để hiển thị (vd: công thức cấu tạo ở câu 18)
if (lowerPath.endsWith('.emf') && hasBlip && !oleIds.length) {
const emfInfo = emfToPngInfo(await fileEntry.async('uint8array'));
if (emfInfo) {
const dw = origW > 40 ? origW : emfInfo.w, dh = origW > 40 ? origH : emfInfo.h;
const emfToken = `@@IMG_${btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(emfInfo.dataUrl + alSuffix())))}${dw > 40 ? `~${dw}x${dh}` : ''}@@`;
if (cacheKey) cache.set(cacheKey, emfToken);
decodedMathFormulaCount++;
return emfToken;
}
}
if (lowerPath.endsWith('.wmf') || lowerPath.endsWith('.emf')) {
const uint8 = await fileEntry.async('uint8array');
const mtefBytes = extractMtefFromWmfBytes(uint8) || extractEquationNativeFromOLE2(uint8);
if (mtefBytes) {
latexResult = parseMtefBytesToLatex(mtefBytes);
}
if (!latexResult) {
latexResult = parseWmfRecordsFallbackToLatex(uint8);
}
// A WMF can contain readable equation glyphs even when its
// MathType MTEF comment is absent. Keep the extracted glyph
// sequence instead of silently dropping the equation.
if (latexResult) {
latexResult = String(latexResult)
.replace(/\u0000/g, '')
.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' ')
.replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ')
.trim();
}
if (latexResult) break;
} else if (/\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|webp)$/i.test(lowerPath)) {
const b64 = await fileEntry.async('base64');
const ext = lowerPath.split('.').pop();
const mime = ext === 'svg' ? 'image/svg+xml' : `image/${ext === 'jpg' ? 'jpeg' : ext}`;
const dataUrl = `data:${mime};base64,${b64}`;
const token = `@@IMG_${btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(dataUrl + alSuffix())))}${origW > 40 ? `~${origW}x${origH}` : ''}@@`;
if (cacheKey) cache.set(cacheKey, token);
decodedMathFormulaCount++;
return token;
}
}
}

const finalToken = latexResult ? `$${latexResult}$` : '';
if (cacheKey) cache.set(cacheKey, finalToken);
if (finalToken) decodedMathFormulaCount++;
return finalToken;
}

function convertWordEqFieldToLatex(instrStr) {
if (!instrStr || !/\bEQ\b/i.test(instrStr)) return '';
let s = instrStr.replace(/^\s*EQ\s+/i, '').trim();
s = s.replace(/\\f\s*\(\s*([^,;]+?)\s*[,;]\s*([^)]+?)\s*\)/gi, '\\frac{$1}{$2}');
s = s.replace(/\\r\s*\(\s*([^,;)]+?)\s*[,;]\s*([^)]+?)\s*\)/gi, '\\sqrt[$1]{$2}');
s = s.replace(/\\r\s*\(\s*([^)]+?)\s*\)/gi, '\\sqrt{$1}');
s = s.replace(/\\s\\up\d*\s*\(\s*([^)]+?)\s*\)/gi, '^{$1}');
s = s.replace(/\\s\\do\d*\s*\(\s*([^)]+?)\s*\)/gi, '_{$1}');
return s ? `$${s}$` : '';
}

function findDirectChildByLocalName(parent, localName) {
if (!parent || !parent.childNodes) return null;
for (let i = 0; i < parent.childNodes.length; i++) {
if (parent.childNodes[i].localName === localName) {
return parent.childNodes[i];
}
}
return null;
}

function findDirectChildrenByLocalName(parent, localName) {
const list = [];
if (!parent || !parent.childNodes) return list;
for (let i = 0; i < parent.childNodes.length; i++) {
if (parent.childNodes[i].localName === localName) {
list.push(parent.childNodes[i]);
}
}
return list;
}

function convertOmmlNodeToLatex(node, styleTracker = { b: false, u: false }) {
if (!node) return '';
const local = node.localName;

if (local === 'oMathPara' || local === 'oMath') {
let inner = '';
for (let i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
inner += convertOmmlNodeToLatex(node.childNodes[i], styleTracker);
}
return inner.trim();
}

if (local === 'r') {
for (let i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
const chNode = node.childNodes[i];
if (chNode.localName === 'rPr') {
if (checkRunBold(chNode)) styleTracker.b = true;
if (checkRunUnderline(chNode)) styleTracker.u = true;
}
}
let text = '';
for (let i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
const chNode = node.childNodes[i];
if (chNode.localName === 't' || chNode.localName === 'delText') {
text += chNode.textContent || '';
}
}
return text;
}

if (local === 'f') {
const fPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'fPr');
const typeEl = fPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(fPr, 'type') : null;
const fType = typeEl ? getXmlAttrVal(typeEl) : '';
const num = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'num'), styleTracker);
const den = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'den'), styleTracker);
if (fType === 'lin') return `${num}/${den}`;
return `\\frac{${num}}{${den}}`;
}

if (local === 'rad') {
const radPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'radPr');
const degHideEl = radPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(radPr, 'degHide') : null;
const degHide = degHideEl ? getXmlAttrVal(degHideEl) : '';
const deg = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'deg'), styleTracker).trim();
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
if (deg && degHide !== '1' && degHide !== 'true') {
return `\\sqrt[${deg}]{${base}}`;
}
return `\\sqrt{${base}}`;
}

if (local === 'sSup') {
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
const sup = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'sup'), styleTracker);
const wrappedBase = base.length > 1 && !base.startsWith('{') ? `{${base}}` : base;
return `${wrappedBase}^{${sup}}`;
}

if (local === 'sSub') {
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
const sub = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'sub'), styleTracker);
const wrappedBase = base.length > 1 && !base.startsWith('{') ? `{${base}}` : base;
return `${wrappedBase}_{${sub}}`;
}

if (local === 'sSubSup') {
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
const sub = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'sub'), styleTracker);
const sup = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'sup'), styleTracker);
const wrappedBase = base.length > 1 && !base.startsWith('{') ? `{${base}}` : base;
return `${wrappedBase}_{${sub}}^{${sup}}`;
}

if (local === 'sPre') {
const sub = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'sub'), styleTracker);
const sup = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'sup'), styleTracker);
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
return `{}_{${sub}}^{${sup}}${base}`;
}

if (local === 'nary') {
const naryPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'naryPr');
const chrEl = naryPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(naryPr, 'chr') : null;
const chr = chrEl ? getXmlAttrVal(chrEl) : '∫';
let op = '\\int';
if (chr === '∑') op = '\\sum';
else if (chr === '∏') op = '\\prod';
else if (chr === '∪') op = '\\bigcup';
else if (chr === '∩') op = '\\bigcap';
const sub = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'sub'), styleTracker).trim();
const sup = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'sup'), styleTracker).trim();
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
let res = op;
if (sub) res += `_{${sub}}`;
if (sup) res += `^{${sup}}`;
return `${res} ${base}`;
}

if (local === 'limLow') {
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
const lim = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'lim'), styleTracker);
return `${base}_{${lim}}`;
}

if (local === 'limUpp') {
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
const lim = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'lim'), styleTracker);
return `\\overset{${lim}}{${base}}`;
}

if (local === 'd') {
const dPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'dPr');
const begEl = dPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(dPr, 'begChr') : null;
const endEl = dPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(dPr, 'endChr') : null;
const sepEl = dPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(dPr, 'sepChr') : null;
const begChr = begEl ? getXmlAttrVal(begEl) : '(';
const endChr = endEl ? getXmlAttrVal(endEl) : ')';
const sepChr = sepEl ? getXmlAttrVal(sepEl) : '|';

const eNodes = findDirectChildrenByLocalName(node, 'e');
const parts = eNodes.map(e => convertOmmlNodeToLatex(e, styleTracker));

if (begChr === '{' && (!endChr || endChr === '')) {
return `\\begin{cases} ${parts.join(' \\\\ ')} \\end{cases}`;
}
const leftDelim = begChr === '{' ? '\\{' : (begChr || '');
const rightDelim = endChr === '}' ? '\\}' : (endChr || '');
return `${leftDelim}${parts.join(` ${sepChr} `)}${rightDelim}`;
}

if (local === 'eqArr') {
const eNodes = findDirectChildrenByLocalName(node, 'e');
const rows = eNodes.map(e => convertOmmlNodeToLatex(e, styleTracker));
if (rows.length <= 1) return rows.join('');
return `\\begin{aligned} ${rows.join(' \\\\ ')} \\end{aligned}`;
}

if (local === 'm') {
const mrNodes = findDirectChildrenByLocalName(node, 'mr');
const rows = mrNodes.map(mr => {
const cells = findDirectChildrenByLocalName(mr, 'e').map(e => convertOmmlNodeToLatex(e, styleTracker));
return cells.join(' & ');
});
return `\\begin{pmatrix} ${rows.join(' \\\\ ')} \\end{pmatrix}`;
}

if (local === 'acc') {
const accPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'accPr');
const chrEl = accPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(accPr, 'chr') : null;
const chr = chrEl ? getXmlAttrVal(chrEl) : '';
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
if (chr === '^' || chr === '\u0302' || chr === '\u02C6') {
return `\\hat{${base}}`;
}
if (chr === '¯' || chr === '\u0304' || chr === '\u0305') {
return `\\overline{${base}}`;
}
return `\\vec{${base}}`;
}

if (local === 'bar') {
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
return `\\overline{${base}}`;
}

if (local === 'func') {
const fName = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'fName'), styleTracker).trim();
const base = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'e'), styleTracker);
return `${fName} ${base}`;
}

let combined = '';
if (node.childNodes) {
for (let i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
combined += convertOmmlNodeToLatex(node.childNodes[i], styleTracker);
}
}
return combined;
}

// ============================================================
// [CODE8] NÂNG CẤP NHẬP WORD: đọc styles.xml + numbering.xml,
// nhận diện đáp án tô màu đỏ / highlight / nền (shading)
// ============================================================
function isRedishHex(hex) {
if (!/^[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(hex || '')) return false;
const r = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 2), 16);
const g = parseInt(hex.slice(2, 4), 16);
const bl = parseInt(hex.slice(4, 6), 16);
return r >= 170 && g <= 90 && bl <= 90;
}

// Chữ có đánh dấu nổi bật: highlight, màu đỏ, hoặc nền (shading) khác trắng
function checkRunHighlight(rPr) {
if (!rPr || !rPr.childNodes) return false;
for (let i = 0; i < rPr.childNodes.length; i++) {
const n = rPr.childNodes[i];
if (n.localName === 'highlight') {
const v = getXmlAttrVal(n).toLowerCase();
if (v && v !== 'none' && v !== 'white') return true;
} else if (n.localName === 'color') {
if (isRedishHex(getXmlAttrVal(n))) return true;
} else if (n.localName === 'shd') {
const f = (getXmlAttrVal(n, 'fill') || '').toLowerCase();
if (f && f !== 'auto' && f !== 'ffffff') return true;
}
}
return false;
}

function nodeHasHighlight(node) {
if (!node) return false;
if (node.localName === 'rPr' && checkRunHighlight(node)) return true;
if (node.childNodes) {
for (let i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
if (nodeHasHighlight(node.childNodes[i])) return true;
}
}
return false;
}

function formatNumberingValue(v, fmt) {
const letter = (n, upper) => {
let s = '';
let x = n;
while (x > 0) {
const rem = (x - 1) % 26;
s = String.fromCharCode((upper ? 65 : 97) + rem) + s;
x = Math.floor((x - 1) / 26);
}
return s || String(n);
};
const roman = (n, upper) => {
const map = [[1000, 'M'], [900, 'CM'], [500, 'D'], [400, 'CD'], [100, 'C'], [90, 'XC'], [50, 'L'], [40, 'XL'], [10, 'X'], [9, 'IX'], [5, 'V'], [4, 'IV'], [1, 'I']];
let s = '';
let x = n;
for (const [val, sym] of map) {
while (x >= val) { s += sym; x -= val; }
}
return upper ? s : s.toLowerCase();
};
switch (fmt) {
case 'upperLetter': return letter(v, true);
case 'lowerLetter': return letter(v, false);
case 'upperRoman': return roman(v, true);
case 'lowerRoman': return roman(v, false);
case 'decimalZero': return String(v).padStart(2, '0');
default: return String(v);
}
}

async function loadDocxStylesAndNumbering(zip) {
const ctx = { styles: {}, nums: {}, abstracts: {}, counters: {} };
const parseXml = async (path) => {
const f = zip.file(path);
if (!f) return null;
try {
return new DOMParser().parseFromString(await f.async('string'), 'application/xml');
} catch (e) {
return null;
}
};
const valOf = (el) => getXmlAttrVal(el, 'val');

// ---- styles.xml: kiểu chữ (đậm / gạch chân / tô màu) theo Style ----
const sDoc = await parseXml('word/styles.xml');
if (sDoc) {
const all = sDoc.getElementsByTagName('*');
for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
const n = all[i];
if (n.localName !== 'style') continue;
const id = getXmlAttrVal(n, 'styleId');
if (!id) continue;
const rPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(n, 'rPr');
const pPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(n, 'pPr');
const tPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(n, 'tblPr');
const tBd = tPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(tPr, 'tblBorders') : null;
const rec = {
bd: tBd ? hasVisibleBorder(tBd) : null,
b: checkRunBold(rPr),
u: checkRunUnderline(rPr),
h: checkRunHighlight(rPr),
basedOn: valOf(findDirectChildByLocalName(n, 'basedOn')),
jc: (function () { const j = pPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(pPr, 'jc') : null; return j ? valOf(j) : ''; })(), // [CODE161]
numId: '',
ilvl: 0
};
const numPr = pPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(pPr, 'numPr') : null;
if (numPr) {
rec.numId = valOf(findDirectChildByLocalName(numPr, 'numId'));
rec.ilvl = parseInt(valOf(findDirectChildByLocalName(numPr, 'ilvl')) || '0', 10) || 0;
}
ctx.styles[id] = rec;
}
}

ctx.resolveStyle = (id) => {
const out = { b: false, u: false, h: false, numId: '', ilvl: 0, jc: '' };
let cur = id;
let guard = 0;
while (cur && ctx.styles[cur] && guard++ < 12) {
const s = ctx.styles[cur];
out.b = out.b || s.b;
out.u = out.u || s.u;
out.h = out.h || s.h;
if (!out.jc && s.jc) out.jc = s.jc;
if (!out.numId && s.numId) { out.numId = s.numId; out.ilvl = s.ilvl; }
cur = s.basedOn;
}
return out;
};

// [CODE31-BẢNG] Viền của bảng theo Table Style (TableGrid...) -> true / false / null (không rõ)
ctx.resolveTableBorder = (id) => {
let cur = id, guard = 0;
while (cur && ctx.styles[cur] && guard++ < 12) {
if (ctx.styles[cur].bd !== null && ctx.styles[cur].bd !== undefined) return ctx.styles[cur].bd;
cur = ctx.styles[cur].basedOn;
}
return null;
};

// ---- numbering.xml: tự đánh số "Câu 1." / "A." do Word tạo tự động ----
const nDoc = await parseXml('word/numbering.xml');
if (nDoc) {
const all = nDoc.getElementsByTagName('*');
for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
const n = all[i];
if (n.localName === 'abstractNum') {
const id = getXmlAttrVal(n, 'abstractNumId');
const lvls = {};
const lvlNodes = findDirectChildrenByLocalName(n, 'lvl');
lvlNodes.forEach(l => {
const il = parseInt(getXmlAttrVal(l, 'ilvl') || '0', 10) || 0;
lvls[il] = {
start: parseInt(valOf(findDirectChildByLocalName(l, 'start')) || '1', 10) || 1,
fmt: valOf(findDirectChildByLocalName(l, 'numFmt')) || 'decimal',
text: valOf(findDirectChildByLocalName(l, 'lvlText'))
};
});
ctx.abstracts[id] = lvls;
} else if (n.localName === 'num') {
const numId = getXmlAttrVal(n, 'numId');
const abs = valOf(findDirectChildByLocalName(n, 'abstractNumId'));
const overrides = {};
findDirectChildrenByLocalName(n, 'lvlOverride').forEach(o => {
const il = parseInt(getXmlAttrVal(o, 'ilvl') || '0', 10) || 0;
const so = findDirectChildByLocalName(o, 'startOverride');
if (so) overrides[il] = parseInt(valOf(so) || '1', 10) || 1;
});
ctx.nums[numId] = { abs, overrides };
}
}
}

ctx.nextLabel = (numId, ilvl) => {
if (!numId || numId === '0') return '';
const num = ctx.nums[numId];
if (!num) return '';
const lvls = ctx.abstracts[num.abs];
if (!lvls || !lvls[ilvl]) return '';
const startOf = (l) => (num.overrides[l] !== undefined ? num.overrides[l] : (lvls[l] ? lvls[l].start : 1));
const arr = ctx.counters[numId] || (ctx.counters[numId] = []);
arr[ilvl] = (arr[ilvl] === undefined) ? startOf(ilvl) : arr[ilvl] + 1;
for (let k = ilvl + 1; k < arr.length; k++) arr[k] = undefined;
const lvl = lvls[ilvl];
if (lvl.fmt === 'bullet' || lvl.fmt === 'none' || !lvl.text) return '';
return lvl.text.replace(/%(\d)/g, (m, d) => {
const li = parseInt(d, 10) - 1;
const v = arr[li] !== undefined ? arr[li] : startOf(li);
const f = lvls[li] ? lvls[li].fmt : 'decimal';
return formatNumberingValue(v, f);
});
};

return ctx;
}

async function extractRichLinesFromDocx(arrayBuffer) {
const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(arrayBuffer);
return extractRichLinesFromDocxBuffer({
arrayBuffer,
zip,
formulaCache: new Map()
});
}

async function extractRichLinesFromDocxBuffer(bufferObj) {
const zip = bufferObj.zip;
const docFile = zip.file('word/document.xml');
if (!docFile) throw new Error('Không tìm thấy word/document.xml');

// Đọc bảng ánh xạ liên kết word/_rels/document.xml.rels để lấy đường dẫn MathType OLE & WMF
const relsMap = {};
const relsFile = zip.file('word/_rels/document.xml.rels');
if (relsFile) {
try {
const relsXml = await relsFile.async('string');
const relsDoc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(relsXml, 'application/xml');
const relNodes = relsDoc.getElementsByTagName('*');
for (let i = 0; i < relNodes.length; i++) {
if (relNodes[i].localName === 'Relationship') {
const id = relNodes[i].getAttribute('Id') || getXmlAttrVal(relNodes[i], 'Id');
const target = relNodes[i].getAttribute('Target') || getXmlAttrVal(relNodes[i], 'Target');
if (id && target) {
relsMap[String(id).trim()] = resolveDocxTargetPath(target);
}
}
}
} catch (e) {}
}

const xmlText = await docFile.async('string');
const parser = new DOMParser();
const xmlDoc = parser.parseFromString(xmlText, 'application/xml');

const docCtx = await loadDocxStylesAndNumbering(zip);
let curPara = { b: false, u: false, h: false };
let curRunH = false;
const richLines = [];

function pushLatexTokenToChars(latexToken, currentChars, isBold, isUnderline) {
if (!latexToken) return;
// [CODE10] Word có thể không có dấu cách quanh công thức ("xạ thủ$A$và") -> thêm dấu cách để không dính chữ
if (latexToken.charAt(0) === '$' && currentChars.length) {
const last = currentChars[currentChars.length - 1];
if (!last.inMath && /[\p{L}\p{N}]/u.test(last.ch)) {
currentChars.push({ ch: ' ', b: false, u: false, vert: null, h: curRunH });
}
}
for (const ch of latexToken) {
currentChars.push({
ch,
b: isBold,
u: isUnderline,
vert: null,
inMath: true,
h: curRunH
});
}
}

async function collectRunNodes(node, currentChars, inheritedBold = false, inheritedUnderline = false, inheritedVert = null) {
if (!node) return;
const local = node.localName;

// [CODE8] Bỏ qua chữ đã bị xóa khi bật Theo dõi thay đổi (Track Changes)
if (local === 'del' || local === 'moveFrom') return;

if (local === 'AlternateContent') {
const choiceNode = findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'Choice');
const fallbackNode = findDirectChildByLocalName(node, 'Fallback');
const beforeLen = currentChars.length;
if (choiceNode) {
await collectRunNodes(choiceNode, currentChars, inheritedBold, inheritedUnderline, inheritedVert);
}
if (currentChars.length === beforeLen && fallbackNode) {
await collectRunNodes(fallbackNode, currentChars, inheritedBold, inheritedUnderline, inheritedVert);
}
return;
}

if (local === 'oMath' || local === 'oMathPara') {
const styleTracker = { b: inheritedBold, u: inheritedUnderline };
const latex = convertOmmlNodeToLatex(node, styleTracker).trim();
if (latex) {
decodedMathFormulaCount++;
const prevH = curRunH;
curRunH = prevH || nodeHasHighlight(node);
pushLatexTokenToChars(`$${latex}$`, currentChars, styleTracker.b, styleTracker.u);
curRunH = prevH;
}
return;
}

if (local === 'object' || local === 'pict' || local === 'drawing') {
const formulaToken = await decodeDocxFormulaObject(node, relsMap, bufferObj);
if (formulaToken) {
pushLatexTokenToChars(formulaToken, currentChars, inheritedBold, inheritedUnderline);
}
return;
}

if (local === 'fldSimple') {
const instr = getXmlAttrVal(node, 'instr');
const eqLatex = convertWordEqFieldToLatex(instr);
if (eqLatex) {
decodedMathFormulaCount++;
pushLatexTokenToChars(eqLatex, currentChars, inheritedBold, inheritedUnderline);
return;
}
}

if (local === 'sub' || local === 'sup') {
const vMode = local === 'sub' ? 'sub' : 'sup';
for (let i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
await collectRunNodes(node.childNodes[i], currentChars, inheritedBold, inheritedUnderline, vMode);
}
return;
}

if (local === 'r') {
let b = inheritedBold;
let u = inheritedUnderline;
let vert = inheritedVert;
let runFontType = null;
let it = false;
let h = curPara.h;
if (curPara.b) b = true;
if (curPara.u) u = true;
for (let i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
if (node.childNodes[i].localName === 'rPr') {
const rp = node.childNodes[i];
if (checkRunBold(rp)) b = true;
if (checkRunUnderline(rp)) u = true;
if (checkRunHighlight(rp)) h = true;
const rsEl = findDirectChildByLocalName(rp, 'rStyle');
if (rsEl) {
const st = docCtx.resolveStyle(getXmlAttrVal(rsEl, 'val'));
if (st.b) b = true;
if (st.u) u = true;
if (st.h) h = true;
}
const vAlign = checkRunVertAlign(rp);
if (vAlign) vert = vAlign;
runFontType = checkRunSymbolFont(rp);
if (checkRunItalic(rp)) it = true;
}
}
const prevRunH = curRunH;
curRunH = h;
for (let i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
const child = node.childNodes[i];
const cName = child.localName;
if (cName === 't' || cName === 'delText') {
const rawTxt = child.textContent || '';
const txt = mapPrivateUseCharsInText(rawTxt, runFontType);
for (const ch of txt) {
if (currentChars.length) {
const lastC = currentChars[currentChars.length - 1];
if (lastC.inMath && lastC.ch === '$' && /\p{L}/u.test(ch)) {
currentChars.push({ ch: ' ', b, u, vert, h });
}
}
currentChars.push({ ch, b, u, vert, h, i: it });
}
} else if (cName === 'sym') {
const charCode = (getXmlAttrVal(child, 'char') || '').toUpperCase();
const fontAttr = (getXmlAttrVal(child, 'font') || '').toLowerCase();
let mappedSym = SYMBOL_FONT_CHAR_MAP[charCode] || '';
if (!mappedSym && charCode.length >= 2) {
const byteVal = parseInt(charCode.slice(-2), 16);
if (!isNaN(byteVal)) {
mappedSym = decodeSymbolByteToLatexOrChar(byteVal, fontAttr.includes('extra') ? 'mtextra' : 'symbol');
}
}
if (mappedSym) {
for (const ch of mappedSym) {
currentChars.push({ ch, b, u, vert, h });
}
}
} else if (cName === 'object' || cName === 'pict' || cName === 'drawing' || cName === 'AlternateContent' || cName === 'oMath') {
await collectRunNodes(child, currentChars, b, u, vert);
} else if (cName === 'instrText') {
const eqLatex = convertWordEqFieldToLatex(child.textContent || '');
if (eqLatex) {
decodedMathFormulaCount++;
pushLatexTokenToChars(eqLatex, currentChars, b, u);
}
} else if (cName === 'tab' || cName === 'ptab') {
currentChars.push({ ch: '\t', b: false, u: false, vert: null });
} else if (cName === 'br' || cName === 'cr') {
currentChars.push({ ch: '\n', b: false, u: false, vert: null });
}
}
curRunH = prevRunH;
return;
}

for (let i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
await collectRunNodes(node.childNodes[i], currentChars, inheritedBold, inheritedUnderline, inheritedVert);
}
}

const hasAnc = (node, name) => {
let p = node.parentNode;
while (p) { if (p.localName === name) return true; p = p.parentNode; }
return false;
};

// Xử lý 1 đoạn văn <w:p> -> mảng ký tự có định dạng (hoặc null nếu rỗng)
async function processParagraph(el) {
let pBold = false;
let pUnderline = false;
let hasNumPr = false;
let numId = '';
let ilvl = 0;
let pStyleId = '';
let pJc = ''; // [CODE161] căn lề của đoạn trong file Word

for (let j = 0; j < el.childNodes.length; j++) {
const pChild = el.childNodes[j];
if (pChild.localName !== 'pPr') continue;
for (let k = 0; k < pChild.childNodes.length; k++) {
const prChild = pChild.childNodes[k];
if (prChild.localName === 'pStyle') pStyleId = getXmlAttrVal(prChild, 'val');
if (prChild.localName === 'jc') pJc = getXmlAttrVal(prChild, 'val');
if (prChild.localName === 'numPr') {
hasNumPr = true;
numId = getXmlAttrVal(findDirectChildByLocalName(prChild, 'numId'), 'val');
const il = findDirectChildByLocalName(prChild, 'ilvl');
ilvl = il ? (parseInt(getXmlAttrVal(il, 'val') || '0', 10) || 0) : 0;
}
if (prChild.localName === 'rPr') {
pBold = checkRunBold(prChild);
pUnderline = checkRunUnderline(prChild);
}
}
}

// [CODE8] Style của đoạn + số thứ tự tự động (Câu 1., A., B., ...)
const ps = docCtx.resolveStyle(pStyleId);
if (numId === '' && ps.numId) { numId = ps.numId; ilvl = ps.ilvl; hasNumPr = true; }
curPara = { b: ps.b, u: ps.u, h: ps.h };
curRunH = ps.h;
const label = numId ? docCtx.nextLabel(numId, ilvl) : '';

// [CODE161] đoạn chỉ chứa hình (không kèm chữ): ghi nhận căn lề (c = giữa, r = phải, j = hai bên, l = trái) để hiển thị đúng như file nguồn
const jcRaw = pJc || ps.jc || '';
let imgAl = '';
if (!/\S/.test(el.textContent || '')) imgAl = jcRaw === 'center' ? 'c' : (jcRaw === 'right' || jcRaw === 'end') ? 'r' : (jcRaw === 'both' || jcRaw === 'distribute' || jcRaw === 'justify' || jcRaw === 'thaiDistribute') ? 'j' : 'l';
window.__mxParaAl = imgAl;
const chars = [];
await collectRunNodes(el, chars, false, false, null);
window.__mxParaAl = '';
curPara = { b: false, u: false, h: false };
curRunH = false;

if (chars.length > 0) {
if (label) {
const head = chars.slice(0, 14).map(c => c.ch).join('');
const typedLabel = /^\s*(?:câu|cau|question)\s*\d+/i.test(head) || /^\s*[A-Da-d]\s*[\.\)\:]/.test(head) || /^\s*\d+\s*[\.\)]/.test(head);
if (!typedLabel) {
const lead = Array.from(label + ' ').map(ch => ({ ch, b: false, u: false, vert: null, h: false }));
chars.unshift(...lead);
}
}
chars.hasNumPr = hasNumPr;
chars.pMarkerBold = pBold;
chars.pMarkerUnderline = pUnderline;
// [CODE167] căn lề của đoạn chữ trong file Word (giữa / phải) -> hiển thị đúng như file nguồn
chars.jc = imgAl ? '' : (jcRaw === 'center' ? 'c' : (jcRaw === 'right' || jcRaw === 'end') ? 'r' : '');
chars.jcAny = imgAl ? 'l' : (jcRaw === 'center' ? 'c' : (jcRaw === 'right' || jcRaw === 'end') ? 'r' : 'l');
return chars;
}
return null;
}

// [CODE31-BẢNG] <w:tbl> -> dữ liệu bảng { rows:[[{t,cs,rs,al,va,bg}]], w:[độ rộng cột], c:căn giữa, bd:có viền }
// `flat` nhận các đoạn văn trong bảng (dùng khi cần trải phẳng bảng như cũ).
async function tableXmlToData(tblEl, flat) {
const tblPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(tblEl, 'tblPr');
let center = false, bordered = null, anyCellBorder = false;
if (tblPr) {
const jc = findDirectChildByLocalName(tblPr, 'jc');
if (jc) center = getXmlAttrVal(jc, 'val') === 'center';
const tb = findDirectChildByLocalName(tblPr, 'tblBorders');
if (tb) bordered = hasVisibleBorder(tb);
else {
const st = findDirectChildByLocalName(tblPr, 'tblStyle');
if (st) {
const sid = getXmlAttrVal(st, 'val');
const sb = docCtx.resolveTableBorder(sid);
bordered = (sb !== null) ? sb : !/normal|plain/i.test(sid || 'Normal');
}
}
}
const grid = findDirectChildByLocalName(tblEl, 'tblGrid');
const widths = grid ? findDirectChildrenByLocalName(grid, 'gridCol').map(g => parseInt(getXmlAttrVal(g, 'w'), 10) || 0) : [];
const paraAl3 = (p) => { // [CODE167] c / r / l (trái hoặc hai bên)
const pPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(p, 'pPr');
const jc = pPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(pPr, 'jc') : null;
const v = jc ? getXmlAttrVal(jc, 'val') : '';
return v === 'center' ? 'c' : (v === 'right' || v === 'end') ? 'r' : 'l';
};
const paraAlign = (p) => {
const pPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(p, 'pPr');
const jc = pPr ? findDirectChildByLocalName(pPr, 'jc') : null;
const v = jc ? getXmlAttrVal(jc, 'val') : '';
return v === 'center' ? 'c' : (v === 'right' || v === 'end') ? 'r' : '';
};

const rows = [];
const open = {}; // cột -> ô đang gộp dọc (vMerge)
for (const tr of findDirectChildrenByLocalName(tblEl, 'tr')) {
const cells = [];
let col = 0;
const trPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(tr, 'trPr');
if (trPr) {
const gb = findDirectChildByLocalName(trPr, 'gridBefore');
const n = gb ? (parseInt(getXmlAttrVal(gb, 'val'), 10) || 0) : 0;
if (n > 0) { cells.push({ t: '', cs: n }); col += n; }
}
for (const tc of findDirectChildrenByLocalName(tr, 'tc')) {
const tcPr = findDirectChildByLocalName(tc, 'tcPr');
let span = 1, vm = '', fill = '', va = '';
if (tcPr) {
const gs = findDirectChildByLocalName(tcPr, 'gridSpan');
if (gs) span = Math.max(1, parseInt(getXmlAttrVal(gs, 'val'), 10) || 1);
const vmEl = findDirectChildByLocalName(tcPr, 'vMerge');
if (vmEl) vm = (getXmlAttrVal(vmEl, 'val') === 'restart') ? 'restart' : 'cont';
const sh = findDirectChildByLocalName(tcPr, 'shd');
if (sh) { const f = getXmlAttrVal(sh, 'fill'); if (/^[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(f) && f.toLowerCase() !== 'ffffff') fill = f.toLowerCase(); }
const vaEl = findDirectChildByLocalName(tcPr, 'vAlign');
if (vaEl) va = getXmlAttrVal(vaEl, 'val');
const tcb = findDirectChildByLocalName(tcPr, 'tcBorders');
if (tcb && hasVisibleBorder(tcb)) anyCellBorder = true;
}
if (vm === 'cont') {
if (open[col]) open[col].rs = (open[col].rs || 1) + 1;
col += span;
continue;
}
const parts = [], partAl = [];
let align = '';
for (const child of Array.from(tc.childNodes)) {
if (child.localName === 'p') {
const chars = await processParagraph(child);
if (!chars) continue;
if (!align) align = paraAlign(child);
chars.jc = ''; // [CODE167] dòng trải phẳng của bảng không mang dấu căn lề
if (flat) flat.push(chars);
parts.push(richToCellHtml(chars)); partAl.push(paraAl3(child));
} else if (child.localName === 'tbl') {
const sub = await tableXmlToData(child, flat);
if (sub && sub.rows.length) { const tk = encodeTableToken(sub); if (tk) parts.push(tk); }
}
}
const baseAl = align || 'l';
const cell = { t: parts.map((h, pi) => (h && partAl[pi] !== baseAl) ? h + AL_MARK[partAl[pi]] : h).join('\n') }; // [CODE167] đoạn trong ô có căn lề khác đoạn đầu
if (span > 1) cell.cs = span;
if (align) cell.al = align;
if (va === 'center' || va === 'bottom') cell.va = va;
if (fill) cell.bg = fill;
if (vm === 'restart') open[col] = cell; else delete open[col];
cells.push(cell);
col += span;
}
rows.push(cells);
}
if (bordered === null) bordered = anyCellBorder;
return { rows, w: widths, c: center ? 1 : 0, bd: bordered ? 1 : 0 };
}

async function buildTableLine(tblEl) {
const flat = [];
const data = await tableXmlToData(tblEl, flat);
if (!data || !data.rows.length) return null;
return makeTableLine(data, flat);
}

const allNodes = xmlDoc.getElementsByTagName('*');
for (let i = 0; i < allNodes.length; i++) {
const el = allNodes[i];
if (el.localName !== 'p' && el.localName !== 'tbl') continue;
// Tránh lặp lại các thẻ nằm bên trong textbox dự phòng
if (hasAnc(el, 'Fallback')) continue;
if (el.localName === 'tbl') {
if (hasAnc(el, 'tbl')) continue; // bảng lồng nhau do bảng ngoài xử lý
const tl = await buildTableLine(el);
if (tl) richLines.push(tl);
continue;
}
if (hasAnc(el, 'tbl')) continue; // đoạn trong ô bảng do bảng xử lý
const chars = await processParagraph(el);
if (chars) richLines.push(chars);
}

return richLines;
}

function parsePastedWordContent() {
const box = document.getElementById('word-paste-box');
if (!box) return;

const richLines = [];
let currentLine = [];

function pushCurrentLine() {
if (currentLine.length > 0) {
richLines.push(currentLine);
currentLine = [];
}
}

function walkDOM(node, isBold, isUnderline, vertMode = null) {
if (!node) return;
if (node.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE) {
const txt = node.nodeValue || '';
for (const ch of txt) {
if (ch === '\n') {
pushCurrentLine();
} else {
currentLine.push({ ch, b: isBold, u: isUnderline, vert: vertMode });
}
}
return;
}

if (node.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
const tag = node.tagName.toUpperCase();
let b = isBold;
let u = isUnderline;
let vert = vertMode;

if (tag === 'B' || tag === 'STRONG') b = true;
if (tag === 'U' || tag === 'INS') u = true;
if (tag === 'SUB') vert = 'sub';
if (tag === 'SUP') vert = 'sup';

const styleAttr = (node.getAttribute('style') || '').toLowerCase();
if (styleAttr.includes('font-weight: bold') || styleAttr.includes('font-weight:bold') || styleAttr.includes('font-weight: 700') || styleAttr.includes('font-weight: 800') || styleAttr.includes('font-weight: 900')) {
b = true;
}
if (styleAttr.includes('underline') && !styleAttr.includes('text-decoration: none')) {
u = true;
}
if (styleAttr.includes('vertical-align: sub') || styleAttr.includes('vertical-align:sub')) {
vert = 'sub';
}
if (styleAttr.includes('vertical-align: super') || styleAttr.includes('vertical-align:super')) {
vert = 'sup';
}

if (tag === 'TABLE' && !(node.parentElement && node.parentElement.closest('table'))) {
pushCurrentLine();
const tl = buildTableLineFromDom(node);
if (tl) richLines.push(tl);
return;
}
const isBlock = ['P', 'DIV', 'LI', 'TR', 'H1', 'H2', 'H3', 'H4', 'BR'].includes(tag);
if (tag === 'BR') {
pushCurrentLine();
return;
}
if (tag === 'TD' || tag === 'TH') {
if (currentLine.length > 0) currentLine.push({ ch: '\t', b: false, u: false, vert: null });
}

for (let i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
walkDOM(node.childNodes[i], b, u, vert);
}

if (isBlock) pushCurrentLine();
}
}

// [CODE31-BẢNG] Dán từ Word: <table> -> token bảng
function buildTableLineFromDom(tbl) {
const flat = [];
const rows = [];
let anyBorder = Number(tbl.getAttribute('border') || 0) > 0;
const trList = Array.from(tbl.querySelectorAll('tr')).filter(tr => tr.closest('table') === tbl);
trList.forEach(tr => {
const cells = [];
Array.from(tr.children).filter(td => /^(TD|TH)$/i.test(td.tagName)).forEach(td => {
const saved = richLines.splice(0, richLines.length);
const savedCur = currentLine;
currentLine = [];
for (let i = 0; i < td.childNodes.length; i++) walkDOM(td.childNodes[i], /^TH$/i.test(td.tagName), false, null);
pushCurrentLine();
const cl = richLines.splice(0, richLines.length);
saved.forEach(l => richLines.push(l));
currentLine = savedCur;
cl.forEach(l => flat.push(l));
const cell = { t: cl.map(l => richToCellHtml(l)).filter(Boolean).join('\n') };
if (td.colSpan > 1) cell.cs = td.colSpan;
if (td.rowSpan > 1) cell.rs = td.rowSpan;
const al = ((td.style && td.style.textAlign) || td.getAttribute('align') || '').toLowerCase();
if (al === 'center') cell.al = 'c'; else if (al === 'right') cell.al = 'r';
const sty = td.getAttribute('style') || '';
if (/border/i.test(sty) && !/border[^;]*:\s*(?:none|0)/i.test(sty)) anyBorder = true;
cells.push(cell);
});
if (cells.length) rows.push(cells);
});
if (!rows.length) return null;
return makeTableLine({ rows, w: [], c: 0, bd: anyBorder ? 1 : 0 }, flat);
}

walkDOM(box, false, false, null);
pushCurrentLine();

wordImportDraft = (window.CODE121EN && CODE121EN.active) ? CODE121EN.parse(richLines) : parseExamRichLines(richLines); // [CODE121]
if ((document.getElementById('word-quick-answer-input')?.value || '').trim()) applyQuickAnswerKey('word');
renderWordImportPreview();
}

function richToPlain(richArr) {
return richArr.map(c => c.ch).join('');
}

// [CODE167] Dấu căn lề VÔ HÌNH đặt cuối dòng: trái = 2 ký tự U+2060, giữa = 3, phải = 4 (không hiện ra, không làm hỏng bộ tách câu hỏi)
const AL_MARK = { l: '\u2060\u2060', c: '\u2060\u2060\u2060', r: '\u2060\u2060\u2060\u2060' };
function stripAl(s) { return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/\u2060{2,4}/g, ''); }
window.__stripAl = stripAl;

function richToFormattedString(richArr) {
let out = '';
let currentVert = null;
for (let i = 0; i < richArr.length; i++) {
const c = richArr[i];
const v = c.inMath ? null : (c.vert || null);
if (v !== currentVert) {
if (currentVert === 'sub') out += '</sub>';
if (currentVert === 'sup') out += '</sup>';
if (v === 'sub') out += '<sub>';
if (v === 'sup') out += '<sup>';
currentVert = v;
}
out += c.ch;
}
if (currentVert === 'sub') out += '</sub>';
if (currentVert === 'sup') out += '</sup>';
if (richArr.jc === 'c' || richArr.jc === 'r') out += AL_MARK[richArr.jc]; // [CODE167]
return out;
}

function normalizeOptionLookalikes(str) {
return str
.replace(/\u0410|\uFF21/g, 'A')
.replace(/\u0412|\uFF22/g, 'B')
.replace(/\u0421|\uFF23/g, 'C')
.replace(/\uFF24/g, 'D')
.replace(/Đ(?=\s*[\.\)\:\-\/])/g, 'D');
}

function joinRichLines(lines) {
const combined = [];
lines.forEach((line, idx) => {
if (idx > 0) combined.push({ ch: '\n', b: false, u: false });
for (let k = 0; k < line.length; k++) combined.push(line[k]);
if (line.jc === 'c' || line.jc === 'r') { for (const mk of AL_MARK[line.jc]) combined.push({ ch: mk, b: false, u: false, vert: null }); } // [CODE167]
});
return combined;
}

// [CODE8] Bộ tách câu hỏi nâng cấp:
